articleTitle: Systematic error correction method for ground-based MIMO array imaging radar
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the problems of cumbersome implementation and high cost of existing correction methods, a feasible system error correction method for MIMO array radar is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the envelope error of the system is corrected by collecting the metal plate data. Then, the amplitude error and the coarse phase error of the system are corrected by collecting the corner reflector data. Finally, the residual phase is estimated by the phase gradient autofocus algorithm (PGA).

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Grid Material Supply Model Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: From a macro perspective, material supply not only includes the process of materials from the buyer to the seller through logistics, but also covers the entire link from the selection of material suppliers to the delivery of materials. The current research on the optimization of material supply is mainly reflected in the optimization of material transfer and distribution center selection, material inventory and pricing optimization, material distribution vehicle scheduling and distribution path optimization. Taking the power grid material supply as an example, this paper focuses on analyzing the material distribution problem in the power grid material supply process. The radio frequency identification device of the Internet of Things technology can identify the material outbound information, and then locate the material distribution route through the GIS system. Therefore, a grid material distribution path optimization model based on the Internet of Things technology is established. By comparing the actual distribution cost before optimization and the optimized distribution cost, we can see that the optimization model constructed in this paper can plan the optimal distribution path, thereby reducing the distribution cost.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Based on Dual-Encoder Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Accurate network intrusion detection is critical in network security protection and network running properly. Considering the important influence of the imbalance in the number of normal samples and intrusion samples in real networks and the excellent performance of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in the field of anomaly detection, this paper proposes Dual-Encoding Generative Adversarial Network (DE-GAN), which only use normal data for training. In this model, an encoder is added before and after the generator. The former encoder inputs real samples and learns its features through stacked convolutional layers, and then the generator reconstructs the feature vectors into fake samples; the latter encoder learns the fake samples feature. Finally, real samples and fake samples are fed to the discriminator to distinguish and score them. During training, on the one hand, the feature learning and data generation capabilities are improved by reducing the feature difference between the outputs of the two encoders and reducing the reconstruction difference between the data before and after reconstruction; and on the other hand, the discriminative ability is improved by reducing the score difference between real samples and fake samples. During testing, the feature difference, reconstruction difference and score difference are summed to detect network intrusion data based on the size of the sum. A case study based on the KDD99 dataset shows that this model can improve the accuracy of network intrusion. Comparisons with commonly used traditional machine learning and deep learning models show that the proposed model outperforms these network intrusion detection methods in terms of accuracy rate, detection rate, and false positive rate.

articleTitle: Comparison of COVID-19 images classification based on different fusion methods
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The COVID-19 has lasted for more than two years, it still affect people's lives. So it is particularly important to quickly and accurately identify covid-19 images. In this paper, we compared the performance of different feature fusion methods base on VGG19 and ResNet50 for classifying COVID-19 images. Firstly, the two basic network models are used to extract the features from multiple levels and then the extracted features are fused using concat and add, respectively. The fused features are extracted through a convolutional pooling module and finally a layer of full connection and SoftMax are used for classification. In addition, COVID-19 images classification are compared using VGG19, ResNet50 models, and two fusion models. Results show that the accuracy, sensitivity and F1 score of the concat fusion model are 96.8%, 100% and 95.1%.

articleTitle: Multi-instrument signal Recognition on account of con-volutional NN
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of multi instrument recognition, a multi instrument signal identification system ConvNet on account of con-volutional NN is proposed. The basic principle and network structure of con-volutional NN are analyzed. Then IRMAS data set is used, It is divided into training and test data sets. To improve the accuracy and precision of the instrument signal recognition more, need to data preprocessing of the data collection, data processing after the success, ConvNet instrument recognition system is built, through this system implementation on the violin, piano, guitar and other instrument signal classification. The results indicate that the con-volution NN multi instrument signal recognition system proposed in this paper has high recognition accuracy. Under different analysis windows, it can achieve better recognition results, which shows that the system designed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Sound Recognition Algorithm Based on VGGmobNet
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In order to address the problem of the excessive number of parameters and low detection accuracy of the current network model that facilitates audio diagnosis of COVID-19, we proposed a training method based on a three-channel Mel-Spectrogram, which is obtained by multi-scale window size and hop length. Besides, we put forward an improved VGGish network based on inverted residual block, while reducing the number of parameters, speeding up the model training process by using transfer learning. Compared with AlexNet, VGG16 and other neural network, the VGGmobNet network model proposed in this paper has fewer parameters, with an accuracy of 85.2%.

articleTitle: Grid planning technology and popularization and application of local distribution network based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: For a long time, the development of the power industry has been dominated by the supply side, and the power market has not yet been perfected. The distribution network has complex lines, and there is no reasonable planning and overall planning, which seriously restricts the normal operation and work of the distribution network. The purpose of this paper is to research and popularize the grid planning technology of local distribution network based on particle swarm optimization. The principle and idea of grid planning of distribution network and the idea and characteristics of particle swarm algorithm are introduced, and the typical domestic medium-voltage distribution network wiring form is studied. The traditional substation site selection generally divides the power supply range first, and then determines the location of the substation. The goal is to minimize the network loss of the medium-voltage line in the power grid, and establish a mathematical model for the optimization of the distribution of power supply in the power supply block network. Taking M city as an example, it is concluded that the maximum power supply radius of the medium-voltage feeder is less than 2.5km. The location and power supply range of the substation are in line with the "bottom-up" planning concept of grid planning on the premise of ensuring power supply demand.

articleTitle: Investigation of Network Efficiency Based on LEACH Algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper provides a detailed introduction to wireless sensor networks and further explores the LEACH algorithm, a hierarchical routing protocol in the network layer of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). After summarising the results of previous improvements and further synthesising and enhancing them, this paper proposes an improved LEACH algorithm for the distribution of nodes in WSNs through algorithm improvements and several controlled trials. By adding the immediate state of energy to the parameters of the algorithm, the algorithm is studied, explored, and modified several times to obtain a distribution algorithm that can extend the lifetime of WSNs. In addition, the improved algorithm is simulated and experimented with several times to find the optimal packet size during transmission. Finally, through simulation and emulation experiments, we obtained a new node hierarchy algorithm for WSNs that outperforms the traditional one in terms of survival time and node efficiency, and effectively improves the overall amount of data transmission.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Alteration Information Extraction of Manganese Mineralization in Postmasburg, South Africa
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, alteration information of ferric contamination, hydroxylate, carbonatization and manganese mineralization in Postmasburg area of South Africa was extracted by using ASTER multi-spectral satellite remote sensing data and principal component analysis algorithm according to spectral characteristics of alteration minerals related to manganese ore. The results of alteration extraction are compared with the data of regional geological survey and geochemical survey in the study area, and the distribution law of remote sensing alteration anomaly in regional space is summarized, and the spatial coupling relationship between remote sensing alteration anomaly and regional geology is discussed, which fully verifies the accuracy and reliability of the alteration information extracted in this paper. It can provide technical support for remote sensing alteration information extraction of subsequent mineral exploitation. In addition, the results obtained in this study are mutually interpreted with the existing research results, providing strong remote sensing evidence for the study of manganese ore geology in Postmasburg area.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Mobile User Preference Mining Based on User Context
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of mobile Internet, the research of mobile user Preference Mining has become one of the hotspots in the field of mobile Internet. A data mining reference model for mobile Internet user preference analysis is constructed; and in this framework, a method of mobile user preference mining based on user context is proposed, including of the definition of Context, modeling of user profile based on context, and mining users’ preference based on contextual information. Experiment shows that this method is effective, and is of good practicability.

articleTitle: Design and development of training quality management system of enterprise university and application of data mining technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of high cost, low efficiency and single and backward training management system of current physician training management, this paper deeply discusses the development status and research background of cloud computing and existing physician training quality management system in enterprise universities. By improving the BP neural network, the MSC-BP2 algorithm is obtained, and on the basis of the improved algorithm, a physician training management system based on the OpenStack cloud platform is proposed. Finally, the cloud computing technology framework is analyzed and the MSC-BP2 neural network is tested to realize the sharing of traditional doctor training network, which shows the applicability and superiority of cloud computing in traditional doctor training. The experimental results show that setting the acceleration ratio of equilibrium point to 8 can obtain an effective optimization space, and when the conditions are superior, the physician training model can be optimized and the speed of model training can be improved. Compared with the unimproved BP neural network algorithm and the MSC-BP1 algorithm, the error between the evaluation value of MSC-BP2 algorithm proposed in this paper and the evaluation value of expert is the smallest, and the evaluation score is the highest. Therefore, MSC-BP2 network can improve the management efficiency of physician training.

articleTitle: Research on DC Transformer Technology for Flexible DC Transmission
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Due to the high requirements for the delay time and step response rise time of DC transformers in the application of flexible DC transmission, this article aims at the application needs of flexible DC transmission engineering, through the Faraday magneto-optical effect optical principle and optical fiber sensing medium, design a DC all-optical current transformer for flexible DC transmission. This paper selects Zhangbei flexible DC project and uses flexible DC transmission DC all-optical current transformer to test it.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of Zinc Battery
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Due to their high theoretical capacity and abundance, rechargeable zinc batteries are ideal for future electrochemical energy storage systems. Despite encouraging progress in the development of zinc batteries, a number of challenges, mainly related to the electrolyte system, remain unresolved, limiting them to laboratory research and preventing widespread use as yet. In order to take full advantage of the high energy density of zinc, methods that enable reversible aluminium deposition need to be developed. This article details the challenges faced by zinc batteries and possible solutions. Both solid and liquid electrolytes are included.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of permission management software based on vuetify3.0 framework
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Permission management is an important part of software system, which is very important to ensure the security of application system resources and information. Based on the latest vuetify 3.0 framework, this paper has designed and implemented a lightweight permission management software applied to the workshop information system, which can realize the functions of role permission allocation, query and modification. The software uses modular thinking to separately design the allocation, query and modification functions of role permissions. The front-end uses simple web page design so that the system administrator can quickly and repeatedly switch between the permission allocation, query and modification interfaces. The system administrator's modification information of permissions will be uploaded in real time and saved to the background server, so that the permission management function can take effect in real time. Through a large number of experiments, this paper shows that the software has well realized the permission management function in the workshop information system, and has the advantages of simple operation, high execution efficiency, strong stability and good scalability.

articleTitle: Development and application research of 5G communication terminal in electric power industry
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the evolution and upgrading of the new power system, only relying on the optical fiber network to carry the information communication of the power grid cannot efficiently achieve both multiple services and functions. Starting from the power application requirements, this paper proposes a 5G communication terminal implementation scheme that supports end-to-end networking and has multiple interfaces, aiming to support a wide range of power services. The scheme has been applied in a typical power application scenario of distributed power dispatching. The information communication indicators are tested in the pilot project, which verifies the feasibility of the scheme in power applications and provides a reference for the design of 5G communication terminals in power industry.

articleTitle: Context-aware access control mechanism for service APPs in smart power terminals
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of embedded operating system platforms, many applications have been developed to use resources on smart power-using devices to provide new or enhanced services. These applications can bring convenience to users, but they also have a high potential to misuse resources leading to privacy disclosure. Therefore, a fine-grained resource usage constraint mechanism that considers contextual information is needed. In this paper, an enhanced context-aware resource usage control system is proposed in the embedded operating system to automatically provide adaptive resource usage control when a specific context is detected according to a pre-configured policy, and a policy conflict mechanism is designed considering the policy conflict problem. In addition, to facilitate users with less knowledge in the field of embedded operating systems to configure policies rationally, this paper designs an auxiliary tool that can guide users to configure policies. The experimental results show that the smart power terminal using the mechanism in this paper can operate with lower power consumption and has little impact on the users' usage.

articleTitle: Ship dynamic intelligent rout optimization method Considering terrible weather conditions
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Adverse weather conditions at sea have serious harm to the economic benefits of ship transportation and even the personal safety of personnel on board. In order to effectively avoid adverse weather sea areas and reduce ship fuel consumption as much as possible, based on C algorithm, combined with dynamic modeling and navigation assistance software, and considering the impact of emergencies, an optimized route to avoid bad weather and sea conditions is planned. The feasibility test results show that the dynamic intelligent route optimization method adopted in this paper can effectively reduce the fuel consumption required by ships in bad weather, and can reasonably avoid dangerous meteorological sea areas, which is of great significance to the optimization of meteorological routes.

articleTitle: Research on Detection and Defense Methods of Adversarial Samples
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: As an important part of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning is widely used in computer vision, natural language processing and other fields. Studies have shown that the existence of adversarial attacks poses a potential threat to the secure application of deep learning models, which in turn affects the security of the model.On the basis of briefly describing the concept of adversarial samples, this paper analyzes the main ideas of adversarial attack defense, studies the representative classical adversarial sample detection methods and defense methods, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of various methods from the perspective of defense types and algorithm characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on High Speed and Low Power Comparator Design
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper is a research on the low power and high speed comparators proposed recent years and discusses several design methods of comparator. An improving latch-type comparator with the dynamic bias technique used in preamplifier stage is proposed to optimize energy consumption. On the contrary, an improved double-tail comparator which modifies the circuit structure of latch stage focuses on achieving a better performance of delay at the cost of a worse energy consumption relatively. Another innovative design of comparator that named as three-stage comparator adds an extra amplifier stage to solve the problems of noise and get a lower delay. Because of the additional preamplifier stage, the NMOS pair can be used in both the latch-stage and the first preamplifier stage, increasing speed. The performance of these three comparators are discussed in this paper and some schemes of comparator design are also presented.

articleTitle: Key technology of intelligent monitoring and diagnosis system for electricity safety
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standards, power supply lines are becoming more and more complex, and the hidden danger of electricity safety brings inestimable economic losses. Therefore, monitoring and diagnosis of electrical protection has become a common concern. In this paper, from a new perspective, relying on sensor technology, computer network technology, embedded technology and other iot related technologies, the design of electricity safety monitoring oriented to the application of big data security monitoring intelligent system. Adopted is based on the analysis of the current waveform acquisition and load power characteristic parameter extraction algorithm, in addition to monitoring the real-time safety concerns such as short circuit, overload, with the rapid development of cloud computing method, can also be persistent state of circuit analysis, is aimed at solving the potential danger of conventional circuit protection device found The utility model provides a safety monitoring system for power supply line current extraction, analysis and calculation. This paper is of great significance to improve the safety monitoring effect of ordinary residence, student dormitory, hotel and other places.

articleTitle: Alarm Algorithm for vehicle blind zone based on lightweight network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The a-pillar of a car plays the role of protecting the whole inner structure of the car body. It can protect the people in the car when the accident happens, but the blind area caused by A-pillar is enough to block the whole pedestrian, at present, there is no warning for external danger in the study of A-pillar, so a light-weight YOLOv4 blind area real-time detection method is proposed to solve the problem of external danger detection in the blind area of a-residence. Firstly, the human eye data set of CAS is collected and labeled with labelImg, secondly, a lightweight YOLOv4 detection model is proposed, and the Yolov4 backbone network CSPDARKNET53 is replaced by MobileNetv3 to reduce the parameters of the model, the deep separable convolution is introduced to replace the common convolution in the PANET network of Yolov4. Finally, the detection Head of Yolov4 is improved, and the Yolo Head is replaced by Decoupled Head. The experimental results show that the weight of the lightweight Yolov4 network is only 1/4 of that of the original network, the classification accuracy on VOC12 + 17 was 87.0% , and the detection rate was 56FPS. It can be seen that the light-weight network can be used to detect the danger of the blind area, which can provide reference for the application of the a-pillar blind area research in the actual work environment.

articleTitle: Study on strain field monitoring system in ship transverse under hydrostatic based on OFDR
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper presents the structural weakness of a river-sea-going ship due to the wide and flat design of the ship; we propose the utilize of Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometer (OFDR) for strain field in ship transverse monitoring in hydrostatic loads. The interrogation method is based on high density Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) array with 5mm grating length and 15mm grating spacing as strain field sensors. This system enable demodulate 0.14mm spatial resolution and 0.01muepsilon maximum strain range. Using OFDR interrogation in different hydrostatic loads in ship in order to reveal the characteristics of ship. Measurement of strain field in ship transverse demonstrate the function of the OFDR based on high density FBG array made potential with this system.

articleTitle: Near-Surface Atmospheric Scattering Rendering Method
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Targeted at the problem of the near-surface perspective lacking authenticity and timeliness, the author puts forward an optimized algorithm for real-time atmospheric rendering that takes Rayleigh scattering and Mie scattering. It simplifies multiple scattering in the existing pretreatment atmospheric algorithm, and doesn’t affect rendering. At the same time, on the premise of not affecting the timeliness, it extends calculation of lookup table to multiple frames, to reduce time for looking up and calculation. Experimental results show that, this system has good display and can be applied in various fields.

articleTitle: Research on a New Technology of the Condition Monitoring of Intelligent equipments in Intelligent Substations
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Focusing on the core concept of "regulation and control integrated with operation and maintenance" and expanding intelligent application, the overall design scheme of the online monitoring system for the secondary equipment of the intelligent substation is proposed in this paper based on the digital design of finished products, realizing the functions, such as status perception and safety detection of smart substation secondary system, status assessment technology, fault diagnosis technology and intelligent security measures. At the same, it provides multi-dimensional visual information support and decision-making and safe operation basis for the daily operation and maintenance, exception handling, accident analysis, and maintenance of the secondary system in the smart substation.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent control system for public art light environment based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The traditional public art light environment control system usually has a fixed control mode, which can’t be flexibly adjusted according to the actual environment. This paper proposes a design scheme to predict the temperature by using the change of temperature data as the input parameter of the BP neural network, and combining the accommodating number of people in the public space and the daily traffic level as the system control factor. In this way, the light environment mode of the public art space can be automatically preset according to the ambient temperature and the flow of people information. And it uses different modes to meet people's entertainment spiritual and cultural needs. Compared with the traditional lighting control system, this design has higher flexibility and adjustability. At the same time, the preset mode can also make a more changeable design according to the actual situation of public space.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Obfuscation Malware Detection Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The new malware hides itself through obfuscation techniques and is able to evade existing detection methods. Artificial intelligence technology is a new direction to solve this problem, however, existing malware datasets have data imbalance problems. Therefore, this paper will propose a deep learning-based hierarchical obfuscation malware detection method, and compare it with the experimental control model and other recently proposed research methods, by standardizing, reconstructing and dividing the CIC-MalMem2022 dataset , build a deep neural network, and build a hierarchical detection model. It is proved by experiments that the classification accuracy of the hierarchical detection model reaches 99%, and it can effectively identify the specific categories of obfuscated malware, which is superior to the existing research methods.

articleTitle: Design of PID Controller Based on Matlab Simulation to Improve System Performance
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: At present, the level of industrial automation has become an important symbol to measure the modernization level of all walks of life. In the modern industrial automation process, the controller of the control system mainly adopts the PID controller. Sampling system and continuous system are the most important in signal processing. In the context of this research,this paper focuses on the analysis of the sampling system and continuous system in the signal and system, Including the acquisition, transmission, and transformation process of signals in the sampling system, the composition of the computer control system, the working principle, and the matching and connection of digital components and analog components in the system. Through the experimental results of Matlab and Simulink simulations, the performance differences between the sampling system and the continuous system and various discretization methods are compared. The significance of this research lies in that, on the basis of analyzing the system performance, the PID controller is designed and improved, which improves the system performance and provides an important theoretical basis for a series of subsequent studies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Power Grid Core Business System Based on SQM Information Push
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low data accuracy and recall rate of information extraction and decision-making in the process of power grid business push, in order to improve the application effect of power grid core business system and optimize the overall business function structure of power grid core system, the push content model and user model are established to represent user information, calculate the correlation value of various information, and optimize the push content rules and the push content decision-making method of on-site operation and maintenance of power grid core business system, The alarm information is divided into four categories to obtain the alarm threshold. The experimental results show that its accuracy and recall rate have been maintained at more than 93%, and the information utilization rate is high. It realizes the optimization of the core business system of the power grid and has practical significance.

articleTitle: Construction of a digital twin information platform based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things, information technology has gradually been applied in various fields, and the digital twin platform also needs to establish an information platform through information technology to better serve the storage and analysis of data. In response to this problem, this paper builds a digital twin information platform based on the Internet of Things technology, and uses the gray clustering model to realize the application analysis and research of the digital twin information platform to verify the effectiveness of the platform. It can be seen from the ex-perimental results that the platform application effect is good, and it can assist the relevant departments to provide ser-vice decision support.

articleTitle: Water meter digital timing recognition system based on edge calculation
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Water is one of the indispensable resources in human production and life, so the accurate management and measurement of water resources is also a very important work. According to statistics, many regions in China still use manual meter reading for water meter measurement and water management. Although this method is simple and easy, it is a huge task for staff. In addition, due to the influence of people's physiological state and emotional factors in the process of meter reading, it is easy to cause mistakes and omissions, which has been difficult to meet the current actual needs. In view of the problems of missing and wrong acquisition caused by manual meter reading in many water plants and communities at present, a water meter timing recognition method based on edge computing is proposed, and an unmanned meter reading system using edge computing and computer vision technology is established to realize information-based water resource management, which meets the needs of social development. Firstly, the digital region of the water meter is located by Canny edge detection and Hove line detection, and then the located digital image is Gaussian filtered; Then build the Jetson Nano compilation environment, and finally deploy the YOLO-v3 detection network to the Jetson Nano computing board to complete the digital timing recognition in the water meter. The experimental results show that the detection time of the water meter in the Jetson nano is 8-9s, which meets the actual needs. This method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Simulation and experimental study on macro bending loss of single-mode fiber
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: When light is transmitted in optical fiber, it will produce transmission loss, which mainly includes three categories: absorption loss, scattering loss and radiation loss. For single-mode fiber, when the fiber has been prepared, its absorption loss and scattering loss have been determined, and the radiation loss is mainly affected by the degree of bending. Therefore, the bending loss mechanism of single-mode fiber can be applied to optical fiber sensing. In this paper, the macro bending loss mechanism of single-mode fiber is studied based on D. Marcuse's "straight waveguide equivalent method". The bending loss of single-mode fiber is simulated and analysed by COMSOL simulation software. The law that the bending loss of single-mode fiber decreases with the increase of bending radius and core radius is obtained. The bending loss of five single-mode fibers is measured experimentally to verify the conclusion that the bending loss of singlemode fiber decreases with the increase of bending radius and core radius.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Interior Sound Quality
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standards and the development of social economy, consumers have higher and higher requirements for comfort in addition to basic indicators such as power and economy when purchasing a car. This paper firstly collects the noise signals at the left and right ears of the driver's seat and the right ear of the passenger's seat under uniform speed conditions. Then a subjective and objective evaluation experiment was carried out. The objective evaluation is to obtain the values of psychoacoustic objective parameters such as loudness and fluctuation strength through software calculation; the subjective evaluation is to organize a jury test to subjectively score the irritability attribute of noise samples. Correlation analysis was carried out on all the scoring results of the jury, and finally the subjective evaluation score table of 36 noise samples was obtained. Finally, the correlation analysis was carried out on the subjective and objective evaluation results, and three psychoacoustic objective parameters of A-weighted sound pressure level, loudness, and fluctuation strength were selected as independent variables, and the subjective evaluation score was selected as the dependent variable. The first 32 noise samples are used to build the multiple linear regression model and the BP neural network model, the last 4 noise samples are used to test the accuracy of the model prediction, and the prediction results of the two models are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Mission-based System Reliability Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In order to evaluate the reliability of the operating system, an evaluation method was proposed based on the system missions. Firstly, the mission reliability block diagram was built based on the missions and system structure. Then the item test data was used to evaluate the system mission reliability. The importance algorithm was applied to recognize the critical point of the system, which could point out the focus during the test. The method could be applied to choice the better test program.

articleTitle: A research on thermal resistance simulation analysis for thermal test chip
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The semiconductor industry is developing rapidly in the direction of high integration and small size. Subsequently, the chip will face problems such as thermal failure under high heat flux density and enhanced thermal coupling of multiple heat sources. Therefore, it is particularly important to study the heat dissipation characteristics of chip packaging. Junction-to-case thermal resistance is one of the most important thermal performance parameters for measuring chip packaging. This paper designed a thermal test chip for package thermal resistance evaluation. In this work, the principle and design method of thermal test chip are introduced in detail, At the same time, the thermal test chip is simulated to obtain the main factors affecting the thermal resistance of the chip package. The simulation results indicate that this thermal resistance simulation analysis method has significant value.

articleTitle: Research on modeling method of dynamic satellite communication network based on time cumulative Graph Model
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Due to the large spatio-temporal scale and high dynamic characteristics of satellite communication network, the traditional time window model and the traditional method of simulating dynamic network processing composed of information accumulation in the time period can not meet the needs of satellite network research under high dynamic conditions. Therefore, the dynamic network modeling method of cumulative graph model is proposed, and the related concepts and indicators under static network are extended to put forward the concept and indicators of dynamic network. Simulation analysis is carried out in small-scale quantitative satellite and large-scale quantitative satellite simulation environment to verify the rationality of the proposed model and realize the unveiling of hidden network characteristics under high dynamic network. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Probing fiber parameters and predicting pulse evolution by using machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Ultrashort pulses evolve into seemingly chaotic complex signals in nonlinear systems. These signals carry a large amount of information of the transmission system. Through information extraction and data analysis of these chaotic signals, fiber information can be extracted. However, such nonlinear evolution is computationally demanding and difficult to achieve using traditional methods to extract effective information. In this paper, a method for extracting effective information of optical fiber based on machine learning is proposed, which can be used to realize optical fiber parametric detection. The mean square error detected by this method can be controlled below 1.19%. Further, we use the machine learning method to simulate the nonlinear evolution of the optical signal in the pulse, which can solve the difficulty of optimizing the pulse propagation requires a large number of numerical simulations, and the prediction error of evolution can be controlled below 0.37%.

articleTitle: Index Evaluation System of Service Scenarios Under the Sharing of Energy Big Data
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of energy technology and the complexity of energy network, the informatization of energy big data has become a trend. Under the conditions of market economy, the formation of energy marketization makes data information an extremely important commodity. With the wide application of big data technology in the power industry, the service model of the power industry is developing towards diversification. At the same time, the service demand of power users is also increasing with the development of big data technology, and the existing service model is not enough to meet the needs of power users. Therefore, starting from the information sources of power big data, this paper explores the application of power big data in many aspects, and proposes an information value-added service model based on power big data from three aspects: power grid enterprises, power sales companies, and power customers. So that we can continuously improve the service level of the power industry to meet customer needs.

articleTitle: Research on Composite Rapid Non-contact Detection Method for Surface Defects of Cylindrical Roller
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In the production process of cylindrical rollers, due to the influence of technology and equipment, surface defects are easily generated. The surface defects of the rollers will cause the bearing to break and fail due to vibration during operation, so the detection of surface defects is particularly important. In order to quickly and accurately identify defects, this paper proposes a composite fast non-contact defect detection method based on 2D images and 3D point cloud data. First, image processing technologies such as OTSU threshold segmentation, Blob analysis combined with difference method are used to accurately locate all suspected defects and reduce the missed detection rate. Then use the alpha shapes algorithm to quickly and effectively extract the data boundary points projected to the two-dimensional plane, and then select the least squares method and B-spline interpolation to perform curve fitting to obtain defect depth information and reduce the false detection rate, and finally complete the research of the entire detection method. After experimental verification, the surface defect areas of cylindrical rollers with diameters of 1.5mm, 2.0mm, and 3.0mm are 12, 17, and 49 pixels, respectively, and the minimum depths of central scratches are 0.0681mm, 0.0656mm, and 0.1071mm, respectively. The whole method has important industrial application value.

articleTitle: Development of battery structure and recent structure of lithium-ion battery
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: As the main energy storage method, batteries have become an indispensable energy supply element for today's electrical equipment. The development of modern batteries can not only reduce the mass and volume of the battery, prolong the life of the battery, prevent the memory effect, but also effectively protect the environment. This article has sorted out the development process of batteries with different structures, restored the history of battery development in chronological order, and mainly analyzed the structural reasons and advantages of advanced lithium-ion batteries being widely used in enterprises. Through analysis, passage showed that changing the positive and negative grade materials of the battery can improve the working efficiency of the battery, and the electrolyte and separator determine the safety of the battery. Changing the structure of ion batteries as above is the most effective way to improve the performance of future batteries.

articleTitle: Intelligent identification of railway roadbed diseases based on unsupervised learning
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Ground penetrating radar is the main method for detecting the disease of railway subgrade. It is difficult to establish a GPR image sample set, and it is difficult to carry out image recognition based on supervised learning. This paper proposes an intelligent identification method of railway subgrade diseases based on unsupervised learning, and uses k-means clustering algorithm and LandTrendr algorithm to realize automatic classification of railway subgrade GPR signals. The test results show that this method can distinguish three types of signals: normal, muddy and water-containing, and the classification accuracy rate reaches more than 95%.

articleTitle: A new two-sampling point method for AC short-circuit fault identification
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Effective fault detection method is the premise of stable operation of circuit breaker, and it is also a necessary condition to ensure the safe operation of power system. The advantages and disadvantages of fault detection methods are rapidity, accuracy and stability. The traditional fault detection algorithm will be affected by grid harmonics and noise. The twopoint sampling method uses the signal change rate and the instantaneous value to fit the maximum signal, which also has the above problems. In this paper, a two-point sampling method for fitting the signal change rate is proposed. The instantaneous value and maximum value of the signal are sampled to avoid direct derivation of the signal, thereby reducing the error of the change rate, and then the short-circuit fault is judged by the fitting change rate. The simulation and experimental results show that the fitting signal change rate curve error is smaller, and it is more accurate in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A 100G Signal Acquisition System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper depicts a 100G signal acquisition system based on FPGA implementation, which is intended for signal acquisition in coherent optical communication systems. Four domestic 40G ADC modules acquire the data, which is then processed by FPGAs with high-speed Serdes interfaces and high-throughput HBMs. Experiments have shown that the proposed signal acquisition system can successfully receive and process signals.

articleTitle: Classification of E-commerce Reviews Sentiment Tendency Based on ALBERT-SVM
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: On the e-commerce platform, customer comments are very important for businesses to improve their competitiveness and service level. This paper proposes an sentiment analysis model ALBERT-SVM for E-commerce review text, which combines the ALBERT pre-trained model and Support Vector Machine (SVM). In this model, the ALBERT pre-trained model is adopted to produce the dynamic feature representation of the e-commerce review text, so that the same word has different word vector representations in different semantic environments, and then the SVM classifier is used to classify the sentiment tendency of e-commerce reviews. Experiments are conducted on the dataset of online_shopping_10_cats. Compared with SVM and ALBERT models, F1 value of this model is increased by 7.1 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively. The experiment results show that our model has better performance than existing models.

articleTitle: Design of tower crane anti-collision algorithm based on two-dimensional coordinate system
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: As a common tool on construction sites, tower cranes are widely used because they can greatly promote construction efficiency. As tower cranes are used more and more widely, collisions between adjacent tower cranes and tower cranes and surrounding buildings often occur, which greatly threatens the safety of workers on construction sites. Therefore, in order to solve the problem of tower crane collisions, this paper first analyzes the operation of tower cranes in different situations in detail, and summarizes the reasons for collisions between tower cranes and buildings and adjacent tower cranes. Then, based on the idea of the traditional three-dimensional homogeneous coordinate transformation anti-collision algorithm, this paper designs an anti-collision algorithm based on a two-dimensional coordinate system by classifying various operating conditions of tower cranes in detail, and using the height sensor and Zigbee technology. Finally, compared with the traditional three-dimensional homogeneous coordinate transformation algorithm, the algorithm is simple and the system executes faster.

articleTitle: VideoSAR Target Tracking Algorithm by Integrating Shadow Detection Network and Global Nearest Neighbour Association
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Video Synthetic Aperture Radar (VideoSAR) is a new radar system that can achieve continuous high resolution and high frame rate imaging by using the terahertz band electromagnetic waves as the working carrier. The target’s motion causes its echo signal displayed and defocused, while the shadows appear at the actual position of the target. In this paper, we propose a shadow based VideoSAR target tracking algorithm to detect and track the ground moving target via the VideoSAR image sequences. Considering that the shadow was low contrast and indistinguishable to the background, we propose a CenterNet based shadow detection network to detect the target shadow at VideoSAR frames. And then the Kalman filter (KF) and global nearest neighbour (GNN) association was utilized to associate the inter-frame detection results by minimize the distance between the target motion prediction and intra-frame detections. The experiments on the real VideoSAR data shows that the proposed tracking algorithm achieves higher qualitative tracking trajectories and higher multitarget tracking accuracy (MOTA) than the others.

articleTitle: Research on random error analysis and noise reduction method of MEMS gyroscope
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the low measurement accuracy caused by random error and outliers in micro electro mechanical system (MEMS) gyroscopes, an adaptive Kalman filtering and wavelet analysis based on autoregressive integrated moving average model (ARIMA) is proposed to eliminate outlier noise. Allan variance analysis method is used to analyze the main random noise of MEMS gyroscope in this scheme. ARIMA was used to model the output signal of MEMS gyroscope. The adaptive Kalman filter equation is established to suppress the random error and outliers of MEMS gyroscope. Wavelet analysis is used to denoise the filtered signal. The experimental results show that the quantization noise coefficients of x, y and z decrease by 93.1%, 94.3% and 88.2%, respectively, compared with before denoising. The angle random walk noise of x, y and z decreases by 98.8%, 98.3% and 97.4% respectively. The zero bias instability of x, y and z decreases by 15.6%, 94.6% and 90.7% respectively, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed scheme in improving the measurement accuracy of MEMS gyroscope.

articleTitle: Investigation of the transmission loss in sea fog environment based on Longley-Rice model
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Fog is a common meteorological condition on the sea, which has a significant influence on the radio transmission. The existing models for calculating the transmission loss and the formulas for calculating the fog characteristic attenuation cannot quickly and accurately calculate the transmission loss in sea fog environment. Based on the Longley-Rice model, we established a transmission loss model suitable for the sea fog environment, which takes into account the atmospheric refractivity correction and the fog characteristic attenuation. The effects of the electromagnetic parameters of the sea fog environment on transmission loss are investigated in detail. It is found that for low-frequency radio, the increase in the scale of the fog environment causes a widening range with increased refractivity, thereby reducing the transmission loss of radio in the diffraction region. As for high-frequency radio, the increase in the scale of the fog environment enhances the fog characteristic attenuation in the area, resulting in a rapid increase in the transmission loss. For the same scale of the fog environment, the closer the fog environment is to the transmitting antenna, the greater the transmission loss becomes. Moreover, it shows that the fog environment temperature, fog visibility, sea surface roughness, the height of the transceiver antenna and the radio frequency also have important influences on the radio transmission in the sea fog environment. The research results obtained have a reference significance for improving the quality of maritime radio communication.

articleTitle: Gaze Estimation Based on Single Objective Natural Conditions
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Appearance based gaze estimation has great application value in the field of human-computer interaction. Nowadays, most deep learning methods require a lot of calculation and time. In this experiment, I designed a new mapping algorithm from three-dimensional coordinates to two-dimensional coordinates, and made the fixation point control the mouse movement to achieve the function of human-computer interaction. When the value 1 represents the maximum accuracy, the fixation accuracy of this experiment can be maintained above 0.8 when the head posture is not moving, High accuracy can also be maintained in the case of head posture movement. Compared with the depth learning method, our accuracy is equivalent, and compared with the traditional method, our accuracy is better. Moreover, the method designed in this paper has high fixation mapping efficiency and lower equipment requirements. The method proposed in this paper has great prospects in human eye control computer interaction.

articleTitle: Knowledge Distillation For Deep Learning Based Automatic Modulation Classification
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Many critical signal processing applications benefit from automatic modulation classification. Deep learning models have recently been utilized to recognize modulation, outperforming classic feature-based machine learning techniques. However, for the following reasons, automatic modulation classification remains difficult. Deep learning requires deeper and deeper network structures to attain high accuracy, however there are computing resource and real-time limits in the deployment phase. To solve the deployment issue, this research employs a knowledge distillation strategy to first train a big network and then distill it into a small network, called the student-teacher model. Experiments reveal that when compared to a directly trained simple network, the distillation-trained simple network has better accuracy at a reasonable distillation temperature.

articleTitle: Research on video control algorithm based on eye movement information
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, there is no infrared light source in the line of sight, no eye tracker is used, and a relatively common and inexpensive camera is used to obtain the user's image, so as to realize the real-time automatic control of the video by the line of sight (the user does not need to make additional actions), which can be used to judge the user's perception of the video, and can also be used for contactless human-computer interaction technology to reduce the spread of COVID-19. This paper proposes a method for actively manipulating videos by analyzing the gaze direction of the human eye. The system collects user images through a web camera, and uses the 68 feature point model of the face provided by the dlib library to detect and extract the feature points. According to the circular aggregation and gray distribution characteristics of the pupil, the gradient consistency method is used to determine the position of the center of the pupil, and finally according to the pupil position, it is judged whether the line of sight falls on the screen, and then the video is operated accordingly. In this paper, a method for initial determination of orientation based on nose tip and pupil and a real-time video active switching algorithm based on spatial geometry and user eye movement information are proposed. The experimental results show that the interactive system can better operate the video according to the human eye movement information, and realize the convenient and concise human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: An improved Carrier Tracking Loop Design under high dynamic and low CNR conditions
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The carrier tracking loop faces extreme difficulty in entering a locked-in state under high dynamic and low carrier-tonoise ratio (CNR) conditions, where the relative acceleration between satellite and receiver may exceed 100g (g=9.8m/s^2). To address this issue, this paper presents an improved carrier tracking loop which designs a highdynamic loop filter based on conventional second-order frequency-locked loop (FLL) serially assisted third-order phase-locked loop (PLL). The proposed loop filter adds two processing modules for acceleration and jerk in the secondorder FLL, which considers the effects of the tracking frequency errors generated by acceleration and jerk. The simulation results and comparative analysis demonstrate that the proposed FLL serially assisted PLL can achieve improved tracking performance under high dynamic and low CNR conditions.

articleTitle: An overview in dynamic comparators optimization methods
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This article presents a review of dynamic comparators. A comparator with a dynamic floating inverter amplifier (FIA) achieves the remarkable energy efficiency thanks to a floating reservoir capacitor. an improved binary phase detector (PD), a time-domain comparator makes a low-noise and low-offset design through applying two differential voltagecontrolled delay lines (VCDLs). An edge-pursuit comparator (EPC) eliminates unnecessary energy consumption per comparison based on oscillator collapse, which is an innovative design from previous work. The article covers the characteristic analysis, aiming at providing a useful principle to IC designers.

articleTitle: A Real-time High-reliable Application-specific Fiber Communication System
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper addresses the design and implementation of a dedicated fiber communication system to meet the real-time and reliability requirements of data transmission in several specific application scenarios. The system employs a double-loop structure to improve reliability. Additionally, gigabit serial data transceiver and optical communication technology achieve multi-rate data transmission. A fault handling mechanism is applied to ensure that system failure can be detected and resolved. A prototype based on FPGA is built to verify the functionality and performance of the system. Test results indicate that the effective data transfer rate and the average data transfer delay of the system are superior to those of the FC-AE protocol.

articleTitle: Patent Measurement Analysis of 5G Technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: 5G has the advantages of large amount of data transmitted and processed, which can provide important support for other critical infrastructure. The world's major economies are actively developing patent layouts around 5G technology. Using incopat patent information retrieval platform, this paper makes a statistical analysis on the annual application trend, patent growth rate, patentee competitiveness, technical theme and technical efficacy of 5G patents in the world. Through data analysis, we can obtain important information such as 5G technology R & D status, technology distribution and patent layout, so as to provide scientific reference for formulating industry development policies. The re-search shows that the global 5G technology research and development is in a period of rapid development, and domes-tic enterprises and scientific research institutes should increase 5G core technology research and development and pa-tent application and protection.

articleTitle: Optimization and Simulation of operation flow of Cainiao Station based on Anylogic
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Taking the Cainiao Station of Shandong J University as an example, this paper focuses on the analysis of its operation mode and the factors affecting the operation efficiency, obtains the existing problems of the Cainiao Station by using the modeling and simulation technology of Anylogic software, and optimizes the spatial layout and operation mode of the Cainiao Station in combination with the field investigation and current simulation results. According to the simulation data, the average time of express delivery and warehousing is shortened by 28.26 min, and the average time of customer pick-up is shortened by 0.44 min, indicating that the improved scheme greatly improves the operation efficiency of Cainiao Station.

articleTitle: Research on interactive design method of power self-service terminal based on user experience
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: It is one of the important ways for electric customers to use power self-service terminals to purchase electricity, print invoices and other businesses. However, with the popularization of Internet and mobile applications, the business volume accepted by business halls and self-service terminals is gradually declining. At the same time, it is increasingly difficult to meet the business needs of users, which is difficult to use, maintain and improve. This paper analyses the current situation of the existing business hall and the power self-service terminal, analyses the content, user objectives, business objectives and interaction mode of the power self-service terminal, and puts forward the interaction design method and model based on the user experience model, which provides a reference for the application of the power selfservice terminal.

articleTitle: A fast binary encryption algorithm design for CAPP system
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Encryption is the process of scrambling a message. This process converts the original file known as plaintext, into an alternative form known as ciphertext so that only the intended recipient can read it. As more and more information is stored on computers or communicated via networks, the need to ensure that this information is invulnerable to snooping and tampering becomes more relevant. But unencrypted plaintext files are often stored in information systems, partly because the traditional encryption algorithms are not efficient enough to meet real-time requirements. For this application requirement, this paper proposes a fast encryption and decryption algorithm. The design idea is to split a file into many segments and then disorder them and use multiple algorithms to encrypt each section. By testing files of different sizes, compared with the AES and DES algorithms, the encryption and decryption efficiency of this algorithm has been improved, especially the decryption efficiency. This paper's algorithm has high application value in the information system that requires both security and real-time.

articleTitle: Fast optimization of sparse array antennas based on improved fruit fly algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The sparse array antenna optimization is a high dimensional optimization task, and the speed of optimization is usually slow. In order to improve the efficiency to the sparse array antenna’s optimization, under the constraints of fixing the aperture, the number of elements and the minimum element spacing of the sparse array, a linear generation mechanism of candidate solution based on fruit fly algorithm (LGMS-FOA) was applied. Through the best memory information of individual history and group global history, constitute a multi-strategy hybrid co-evolutionary search mechanism. LGNS-FOA is used to optimize the position of element, and the antenna gain calculation method without integration is applied to obtain higher antenna gain and realize the fast calculation.

articleTitle: Analog Circuit Fault Diagnosis Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimized DELM
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In view of the small feature difference between fault classes and difficult diagnosis in analog circuit fault diagnosis, and the artificial selection of hidden layer nodes will miss the effective feature information of the fault itself, resulting in large training errors. This paper proposes an analog circuit fault diagnosis model based on genetic algorithm (GA) optimized DELM. Because the number of hidden layer nodes in deep network is difficult to select, selecting appropriate hidden nodes can effectively reduce the time complexity, The network has good generalization ability. However, the genetic algorithm can better avoid the model falling into local optimization, has high convergence ability, and effectively improves the classification accuracy of large samples. Therefore, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the hidden layer nodes of DELM, and the testable nodes of the circuit are studied. The best test nodes are selected by comparing the included angles between different fault categories. Finally, it is verified by the nonlinear rectifier circuit. The diagnosis results of hard fault and soft fault show the feasibility of the algorithm. Compared with other algorithms, it is proved that the algorithm can adaptively search the global optimal solution.

articleTitle: 5G Development and Modern Applications
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: 5G is the fifth generation of mobile communication technology. It is a perfection and innovation based on 4G technology, which greatly improves the transmission speed of data information. With the gradual integration of 5G wireless communication technology into people's daily life, It has higher transmission efficiency, data information coverage, etc. in practical applications, and has a good development prospect in the future communication industry. This paper takes the key technologies of 5G as the research object. On the basis of expounding the basic characteristics and development status of 5G technology, it analyzes the key technologies and their applications of 5G, and analyzes their development status in smart medical care, transportation and agriculture. 5G technology will provide people with more efficient and affordable remote treatment in the future. With the blessing of 5G technology in transportation, people's travel will be more convenient , and rail transportation will also usher in new opportunities. It can give full play to the carrying capacity of rail transportation and share the burden of express transportation for road transportation. In terms of agriculture industry, the characteristics of 5G technology make agricultural development more intelligent and rely less and less on labor, which not only improves the efficiency of agricultural sowing and harvesting, but also reduces the probability of low crop yields. This article will provide a reference for people to explore the application and development of 5G and more advanced communication technologies in all walks of life in the future, or guide the development direction of communication technology.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Garment Warehouse Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This article is mainly aiming at the trend of goods inventory and logistics in the garment industry, neglecting the management of the storage environment, an intelligent garment storage monitoring system based on the Internet of Things technology is designed to solve the garment environmental temperature and humidity adaptation, energy consumption waste, gas poisoning and fire problems. The system shares data with the Hewu IOT platforms in the OneNET IOT open platform. The STM32F103C8T6 single-chip microcomputer is used as the main controller. The DHT11 sensor is used to detect the ambient temperature and humidity. The MQ-2 sensor is used to detect the smoke concentration. The JW01 sensor is used to detect the formaldehyde concentration. The photoresistor is used to detect the light intensity, and the collected data is uploaded to the OLED display in real time. The WiFi wireless communication technology is used to transmit to the app mobile terminal for display, and the mobile terminal controls the fan, light and exhaust fan remotely. When the smoke, formaldehyde and temperature and humidity are not suitable for the storage environment of clothes, light flicker of red, yellow and blue colors and buzzer alarm shall be carried out respectively, and the exhaust fan shall be automatically turned on to dehumidify and exhaust smoke. At the same time, the OLED display alerts the staff to open the window or evacuate, and the APP pops up the window to notify the administrator. Through the monitoring of light intensity, the light is automatically controlled to save energy and reduce consumption. Ensure simple and convenient operation, real and reliable monitoring data, reduce the loss of personnel and fire accidents. The results show that the system integrates many functions of monitoring, prevention and automatic control, and can be used to realize and popularize the garment warehouse industry in real life.

articleTitle: EC-DNNs: An efficient Training Engine for Edge Computing-Based agriculture IoT
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: As 5G technology takes hold and matures, mobile computing and the Internet of Things (IoT) in agriculture become more prevalent in the real world, billions of agricultural mobile devices and agricultural IoT terminals are connected to the network, generating countless amounts of data at the edge of the network. The need for constant viewing of crop growth and conditions in the farming environment in agriculture results in a large amount of data being generated on mobile devices and agricultural IoT terminals. In this paper, we propose EC-DNNs, a framework where data information is multivariate classified by DNNs, and deep learning collaborative reasoning is performed through end-device - edge node - cloud server - edge collaboration.EC-DNNNs framework embeds DNNs processing algorithms at edge nodes to selectively keep regular data locally and transmit important information to the cloud, reducing bandwidth waste and lowering propagation real delay, thus improving computational performance and achieving balanced load. The experimental results show that the EC-DNNs framework is effective in achieving low-latency edge intelligence for agricultural IoT end devices and provides a good solution for solving the computation of information transmission of agricultural IoT data.

articleTitle: Research on A-pillar Display Algorithm Based on Line-of-Sight Estimation
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper studied a real-time A-pillar display algorithm based on an improved line-of-sight estimation method. In order to solve the problem of A-pillar blind area, a method based on BoTNet network for line-of-sight estimation is proposed. Compared with the published methods, this method can reduce the average angle error by 9.1%. At the same time, we use two monocular cameras, camera 1 to estimate the driver's line of sight, obtain the coordinates of the human eye according to the line of sight estimation, and use the method of 3D reconstruction of the blind spot to capture the content obtained by the camera 2 in real time and output it to the display screen to realize the blind spot. real-time display. The experimental results show that the frame rate displayed in the blind area can reach the highest frame rate of the network camera of 30fps.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Water-Filling Allocation Plus Fractional Frequency Reuse for 19-Cell Network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In recent years, 5G, the fifth-generation mobile communication system, has become a hot topic in communication industry and academia. With the explosive growth of mobile data demand, the existing mobile communication system is unable to meet the future demand, and a new generation of 5G system is urgently needed. In this paper, based on the original cellular network frequency deployment technology and the user's usage in cellular network coverage, it analyses the progress of the improvement of the integer frequency reuse 3(IFR 3), synchronous water filling (SWF), fractional frequency reuse (FFR), SWF+FFR, IFR+FFR and makes comparison and discussion. By comparing five methods and formulas, the role of FFR in network construction is demonstrated, and the performance of different algorithms is analysed and evaluated based on the average channel capacity. In addition, FFR+SWF is selected by comparison, which can improve the channel capacity and effectively reduce the same frequency interference. The shortcomings of IFR improved by FFR are also used to ensure the number of channels. With the 5G and 6G development, this technology, FFR+SWF will be widely used and play an irreplaceable role in the future.

articleTitle: Joint Beamforming and Artificial Noise Design in Wireless Downlink Networks
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper investigates a wireless downlink communication system with multiple single-antenna eavesdroppers by utilizing artificial noise, which is different from most existing works that allocate the artificial noise to the zero space of the legitimate channel. Assuming that the transmitter perfectly knows the ideal channel state information, an optimal scheme of joint beamforming and artificial noise design is proposed. Under the conditions of ensuring the receiving SNR threshold of legitimate users and limiting the receiving SNR of eavesdroppers, this paper focus on transmit power minimization problem. Although the proposed optimization problem is nonconvex, it can be converted into a convex problem by using semidefinite program (SDP) relaxation method and solved effectively. The transmit power allocation between private signals and artificial noise is solved, and both the reduced system energy consumption information transmission safety are achieved. Simulation results show that the joint optimization scheme consumes less transmit power than the scheme without artificial noise on the premise of meeting the system safety performance.

articleTitle: A Traffic Target Detection Algorithm Based on Hybrid Model Compression Method
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of the computer vision field, convolutional neural networks are widely used in object detection algorithms. However, the deep learning network model has high computational complexity, occupies a large storage space, and is difficult to deploy on low-computing devices. Aiming at the difficulty of deploying traffic target detection algo-rithms in practical scenarios, this paper proposes a target detection network compression method based on fusion of pruning and quantization. First, based on the Yolo series target detection algorithm, we perform an unstructured pruning operation with a variable threshold for the network model to be optimized, which can remove more information than the structure and reduce the parameters of the network model. Then, the network is quantized into 8-bit integer data through quantization-aware training to compress the network size.
