Experiments show that the optimized network model has less accuracy loss after variable threshold pruning and data quantization, and the model size is greatly compressed, which can achieve high detection capability even in the case of limited resources.

articleTitle: Research on few-shot object detection algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the situation that there are few labeled data samples in the neural network, an attention mechanism-based AM-SiameseRPN++ Few-shot Object Detection (FSOD) algorithm is proposed. The AM-SiameseRPN++ model extracts image features by fused residual network, and fuses different features of the multi-layer feature layers extracted by ResNet-50 through the feature fusion module. At the same time, an attention mechanism is introduced in front of the RPN network. The SiameseRPN++ and the AM-SiameseRPN++ algorithm proposed in this paper are used for feature extraction experiments on the Fashion-MNIST dataset. The experimental results show that AM-SiameseRPN++ has better feature expression and feature extraction capabilities than SiameseRPN++. The experimental results of 1-shot, 5-shot and 10-shot FSOD of different categories on the MS-COCO dataset show that AM-SiameseRPN++ model is more stable, has a certain inhibitory effect on the impact of object category growth, and has more advantageous FSOD performance. Therefore, AM-SiameseRPN++ is an effective FSOD algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of Circuit Parameters of Battery Equalization Topology Based on Capacitor and Energy Bus
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Equalization circuit is necessary for lithium ion batteries. A battery autonomous equalization topology based on energy bus is studied. The expressions of equalization efficiency and equalization time are derived through circuit analysis, and the influence trend of both circuit component parameters and clock frequency on equalization efficiency and equalization time is summarized based on the expressions. A set of optimal circuit parameters can be obtained by compromise method to ensure both high equalization efficiency and short equalization time. Saber software was used to build demo of this equalization circuit, which contains six batteries. The simulation results verify therotical analysis above.

articleTitle: Backscattering characteristics of forest canopy for radio fuze
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: When the radio fuze is used in a forest environment, it is susceptible to interference from strong canopy backscattering clutter. In order to study the electromagnetic backscattering characteristics of the forest canopy and improve the ability of the radio fuze to anti forest clutter interference, based on the MIMICS theroy, the backscattering coefficients of radio fuzes under different incident angles, electromagnetic frequencyies, forest canopy height and forest canopy water content are analyzed. The influence model of backscattering coefficient on radio fuze echo wave amplitude is established to provide a basis for determining the optimal burst height. The result can be applied to the parameter optimization design of radio fuze against forest canopy backscattering.

articleTitle: Long-Time Coherent Integration of the Maneuvering Weak Target for Wideband Radar Based on ACCF-LVD-KT
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Compared with narrowband radars, the maneuvering weak target detection of wideband radars faces more difficulties, such as more severe range migration (RM) and Doppler frequency migration (DFM). To deal with this problem, this paper proposes an effective long-time coherent integration (LTCI) algorithm based on ACCD-LVD-KT. Firstly, the Adjacent Cross Correlation Function (ACCF) and Lv’s Distribution (LVD) transform are applied to estimate the acceleration and jerk. Then, the maneuvering phase term is compensated using the estimated parameters and Keystone Transform (KT) is used to correct the range walk (RW). Finally, the high resolution range profiles (HRRPs) of the maneuvering weak target can be reconstructed. Theoretical analyses and simulation examples validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The development of intelligent data service mode of university library applying artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development and application of information technology, intelligent services have become a trend. In the information environment, university libraries are closely related to students' lives as carriers of knowledge and information resources. In the face of the huge and complex information needs, the traditional data service model can hardly meet the current user requirements for efficient and personalized search and collaborative work, nor can it provide high-quality convenient services and product experience for university students. Decision support is a personalised information service model for libraries that is geared towards data mining, classifying and analyzing large volumes of data to draw conclusions. It plays an important role in the storage and retrieval of high-volume and high-value information. At present, the scale of China's university literature resources construction is expanding, but many universities are still in the initial stage of informationization, coupled with the huge volume and variety of library data, therefore, this paper develops a set of intelligent data service model for university libraries based on artificial intelligence technology.

articleTitle: An automatic construction method of village parcel polygons based on adaptive genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the low degree of automation and intelligence in the automatic construction of village parcel polygons, this paper proposes an automatic construction method of parcel polygons based on adaptive genetic algorithm. On the basis of mining the inherent mathematical constraints of parcel polygons, the frequency distribution of parcel corner angle is introduced, and the product of the frequencies of all corner angels of the parcel is used as the fitness function. In order to improve the accuracy, an adaptive optimization strategy is used to initialize the population, and the self-intersection problem of parcel polygons is also considered; The results show that the accuracy is more than 93% and the time complexity increases approximately linearly as the number of boundary points increases. The algorithm can be applied to the automatic processing of data in the geographic information system.

articleTitle: Research on Data Technology in Remote Detection of Transformer Bushing End Screen Fault and Design of Early Warning System
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Oil-immersed power transformer is the main equipment of substation, and bushing is an important component for connecting transformer with power grid. Its function is to lead the leads on the high, medium and low voltage sides inside the transformer box to the outside of the transformer oil tank, and connect with the power grid through the external leads, and at the same time play the role of insulating and fixing the leads to the ground. As one of the important accessories of the bushing transformer, it is responsible for fixing the wires and connecting the inside and outside of the transformer. It has the characteristics of light weight, small volume, good tightness and convenient maintenance. On-site casing requires high electrical strength and mechanical strength, and good thermal stability. Based on this situation, according to the relevant technical standards and specifications, this paper studies the early warning system of transformer bushing terminal screen fault, and proposes an intelligent hybrid method based on fuzzy theory and neural network, that is, the terminal screen fault diagnosis of transformer bushing based on fuzzy relation and self-organizing feature mapping, which realizes the rapid and effective diagnosis of terminal screen discharge, improves the equipment fault early warning ability, provides reliable data for maintenance and evaluation, and improves the accuracy of real-time online fault diagnosis of power transformer.

articleTitle: The Design of Pixel-level ADC for CMOS Image Sensor Resistant to TID Irradiation
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In CMOS image sensor, a pixel level ADC which can resist 5kGy TID irradiation is designed by using a novel S-gate-assisted (SGA) SOI device. The pixel level ADC is an MCBS ADC, which is applied to 4T-BPD pixel units. One ADC is multiplexed for every four pixel units, and only the core circuit module is integrated in the pixel unit, which makes the FF very high, and can easily realize quantization, variable step size and eliminate image lag. The circuit adopts 0.18micrometer CMOS process and 3.3V power supply voltage. The sampling signal frequency is 200kHz, and the input signal frequency is 3.90625kHz. The simulation results show that the dynamic parameter index values are: ENOB = 7.91bits, SNDR = 48.22dB, SFDR = 65.99dBc, SNR = 53.58dB, THD = -56.25dB, and the static parameter index values are: DNL = + 0.41/-0.52 LSB, INL = + 0.87/-1.06 LSB. The power consumption of a single pixel module (4 pixels plus comparator and latch pair) is 4.54muW, FOM ≈ 83.19fJ/conv, and can completely resist the TID effect of 5kGy dose. It has a good application prospect for CMOS image sensors exposed to high-dose irradiation environment.

articleTitle: Moving target imaging for vortex electromagnetic wave radar
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The wave front of vortex electromagnetic wave (VEMW) is spiral in spatial distribution, and different orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes L are orthogonal to each other, which effectively improves the imaging and detection ability of radar. However, range migration, Doppler dimension expansion, azimuth ambiguity and other problems will inevitably be encountered in the echo signal of moving targets. To solve this problem, this paper analyzes the moving target imaging based on vortex electromagnetic wave, and deduces the imaging model of moving target. On this basis, keystone transform is introduced to correct the range walk, and then the error phase term obtained by theoretical analysis is compensated. The simulation results show that the imaging quality is effectively improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Training Samples Selection Method for Space-Time Adaptive Processing
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Estimating the clutter covariance matrix using the training samples is the key step of space-time adaptive processing (STAP). However, a lot of target-free training samples are not available in heterogeneous environments, resulting in the inaccuracy of the covariance matrix. Aiming at the problem, we propose a method using Pseudo-spectral as the test statistic to select training samples. The training sample whose Pseudo-spectral is similar to the Capon spectrum is selected. Moreover, we use subaperture smoothing techniques to estimate covariance matrix which can overcome samples deficiency problem. Finally, the numerical experiments with simulation data and measured data demonstrate the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Frequency Allocation Optimization Based on FFR and Water-Filling Algorithm in Cognitive Cellular Network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G technology which has shorter electromagnetic wave length, more precious spectrum resource and weaker wave diffraction ability than 4G, the demand for the quality of wireless communication is increasing. Therefore, aiming at the characteristics of 5G, a brand-new intelligent frequency allocation algorithm based on Fractional Frequency Reuse (FFR) and Water-Filling power allocation is proposed. So, the cellular network is still the priority. Under the 19-cell cellular network model, the algorithm divided each cell into cell center and edge and give priority to users closer to central base station. The spectrum allocation algorithm of central users is improved by simulations for many times, and interference temperature limit and forward-looking game algorithm based on water-filling power allocation are introduced. It can limit the interference to authorized users and improve the utilization rate of spectrum resources as much as possible. Simulation results show that Forward-Looking Game (FLG) algorithm greatly improves network performance by enlarging network capacity and has obvious advantages compared with other methods. For cell edges which has weaker interference than cell centers, to get a better frequency reuse method. The simulation results show that Integer Frequency Reuse (IFR3) for cell edges can get the maximum network capacity. Meanwhile, the result also shows the most suitable transmit power from base station to cell center and cell edge.

articleTitle: Research on an invasive low frequency power consumption data acquisition method
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the problems of data lag and poor timeliness caused by scattered industrial energy consumption data acquisition equipment and mostly long-distance acquisition and transmission, this paper proposes an engineering oriented invasive and low-frequency power consumption data acquisition method. This method uses the technologies of multi-agent networking, automatic connection, automatic recovery, local sto rage, breakpoint continuation and dynamic loading of adapter mode driver, so as to solve the problems of large-scale, high reliability and strong compatibility in the process of energy consumption data acquisition, so as to improve the quality of data acquisition and achieve the management objectives of maintainability and scalability.

articleTitle: Impedance matching of CG2H40010F using Smith Chart
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The content of this article is to investigate how to use the method of load-pull to match the load impedance of an RF power amplifier. Simulation simulates the impedance matching of the RF power amplifier at fundamental frequency using passive tuned tuners. In this simulation experiment, Wolfspeed's CG2H40010 power amplifier was selected as the device under test, and the relationship between the output power and the load impedance change of the device was studied in the input power range -10dBm to 35dBm and frequency from 1GHz to 3GHz. The result is that when the frequency of the input signal is 1.9GHz, and the power is 32dBm, the load impedance is adjusted to 24.9+j12.7Omega, the PAE has a maximum value of 70.2%, and the output power is 41.68dBm.

articleTitle: Analysis of the progress of machine vision-based surface defect detection technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In industries such as semiconductor, PCB (Printed Circuit Board), automobile assembly, Liquid Crystal Display (LCD), 3C, photovoltaic cells, and textile, product appearance is inextricably linked to product performance. Surface defect detection is an important means to prevent defective products from entering the market. The use of machine vision for inspection is highly efficient and cost-effective and is the main direction of future development. This paper presents a statistical analysis of the number of defect detection objects, defect detection methods and defect detection literature over the last 30 years; finally, it points out the current problems with defect detection methods and provides an outlook for further work.

articleTitle: Simulation of Transistor Nonlinear Models to Validate Load-Pull Theory
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This project aims to study the operation of a passive tuner that works at the fundamental frequency of a load-pull system suitable for RF PA design. By using AWR-MWO software to simulate the circuit to compare the different frequency characterization at the DUT output port under different load and output impedance. The CG2H40010 power amplifier is simulated under different frequencies, input power, and output impedance to achieve the purpose of this thesis. The simulation results show that the input power is 32dBm and the output matching impedance is 24.9+j12.7Omega, the optimal PAE is 70.2%, and the highest output power is 41.68dBm.

articleTitle: MPC-based Motion Control of Underwater Vehicle with Fixed Depth
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the underactuated and nonlinear system of underwater vehicle, this paper studies the control of depth-fixing motion. The first is to analyze the kinematics and dynamics of the underwater vehicle, so as to establish the corresponding depth-fixing motion control model. Secondly, the controller based on the model predictive control algorithm is designed in the Simulink platform to realize the depth-fixing motion control and anti-disturbance test of the underwater vehicle. At the same time, the PID algorithm is introduced to compare the step response of the two. Finally, according to the simulation results, it can be concluded that the controller based on the MPC algorithm can effectively reduce the overshoot of the underwater vehicle, the control system can converge to the target value faster, and has strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Improved Dual-channel CNN-BiLstm rolling bearing fault diagnosis study
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the single-scale network model cannot completely extract the feature information and the fault data has time series, an improved Dual-channel CNN-BiLstm rolling bearing fault diagnosis method (Dual-CNN-BiLstm) was proposed in this paper. Firstly, s-transform was used to process the signal as the input of the model. A two-channel network model was used to extract rolling bearing fault features, a large convolution kernel was used to improve the anti-interference ability of the model, and BiLstm was used to extract time series attributes in timefrequency features. At the same time, the attention mechanism module is introduced to pay attention to the regions with large differences and extract fault information to the maximum extent. Finally, a particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced to optimize the classifier to improve the accuracy of fault identification. To verify the validity of this model, experimental comparisons with other variants of this model on a public data set at Case Western Reserve University show that all of the models presented in this paper have better fault identification performance.

articleTitle: Adder design of three N-bit binary numbers based on hybrid Memristor-NMOS
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The switching characteristics of memristor make it have a good application prospect in digital logic. In recent years, researchers have proposed many memristor-based adder and multiplier logic circuit designs. It can realize the sum operation of multi-bit binary numbers of 2 numbers. However, when encountering an operation of three or more numbers, it is necessary to add two by two, and then add them again, which is time-consuming and wastes hardware resources. Based on this, this paper designs an adder circuit with three n-bit binary numbers, which can realize the sum operation of multiple inputs. Compared with the traditional adder circuit, it not only reduces the expenditure of hardware resources, but also reduces the delay Time.

articleTitle: Research on Benefit Analysis Method of Communication Network Node Repair
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: To solve the problem of reasonably deciding the order of repairing nodes in a communication network with multiple damaged nodes, an analysis method based on repairing benefits is presented. Considering the importance of nodes in the network topology and the business carried in the communication network, this paper uses the weighted LeaderRank algorithm to analyze the importance weights of each node before and after damage, constructs a repair benefit function, and calculates the benefits of repairing each damaged node to the communication network from a system perspective, which provides a new idea for the repair of communication network nodes. The method is proved to be reliable and effective by experiments.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Research on the Voice Communication System Based on Soft Switching
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: At present, the communication network is developing towards Digitalization, Integration and Droadbandization. With the rapid development of Next Generation Network, the continuous application of multimedia communication technology and the maturity of soft switch technology make it possible to integrate heterogeneous multi-networks. Analyzed the characteristics and advantage of soft switching , with the examples of some scientific research laboratory, this paper introduces the specific construction scheme of soft switch technology applied in cross-regional laboratory telephone network, analyzes its implementation in the process of the low cost IP voice communications from circuit switch voice communication system into the soft switch of system architecture design, the advantages of deploying communication network using soft switching are explained.

articleTitle: Two-stage charging scheduling optimization of electric vehicles based on user behavior
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the penetration rate of electric vehicles, it hurts the economic and stable operation of the power grid, to reduce the power grid load fluctuation caused by random charging of electric vehicles, In this paper, a two-stage charging strategy is proposed. Firstly, the probability distribution model is calculated according to the travel characteristics of users, and then the charging model is established by the Monte Carlo method combined with the information on charging piles, battery characteristics, and automobile scale. Finally, the impact of this strategy on the power grid is described by taking valley peak value, saving rate, and travel rate as evaluation indexes. Simulation results show that this strategy can meet the driving needs of users, reduce travel anxiety information, and reduce the peak-valley load gap of the power grid. It is an orderly charging strategy integrating the power grid and user sides.

articleTitle: Intelligent interior design based on BachGAN and StyleGAN2
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Image generation technology can be well applied to the field of design, especially in interior design. This paper will describe some relevant image generation algorithms and applications, including two advanced approaches applied in the field of interior design, as well as introduce in detail two algorithms named BachGAN and StyleGAN2. BachGAN is an algorithm that can generate images by providing salient object layout, and StyleGAN2 is an algorithm that can generate images with specific styles through training. These two algorithms are advanced and can be well applied to interior design. By combining them, a potential approach of generating interior design with a specific style through the layout of the salient objects is proposed. This approach satisfies customers seeking individuality in interior design and helps popularize personal design tools and expands this smart design approach to a wider range of fields.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Crossing Light Assistance System
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The safety of pedestrians in the remote region during the night is a popular question. Recent solutions focus on installing street lamps and traffic lights. However, these solutions may be restricted by urban and rural planning, laying cables, and energy waste. We aim to design a system that is easy to be installed and portable, and energy-friendly. The system consists of the hardcore part and the softcore part. The hardcore part can capture the thermal image of the environment and send the real-time image to the softcore part, the softcore part processes the image, detect the pedestrian and calculate the position. Then softcore part sends a signal to the hardcore part and the hardcore part can project the pedestrian and follow its moving until the pedestrian already crossed the crossing. The softcore has been tested on real-world scenes and shows the effectiveness of the simple blob detector. Finally, this device is easy to be installed and removed, and it can absorb solar energy and the light system can hibernate when there is no pedestrian, so it can save energy.

articleTitle: Integrated Design of Fast Access Regressive Orbit and Maneuver Launch Position
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Based on the orbit dynamics and spherical geometry principles, the design models of fast access regressive orbit and maneuver launch position are built for the typical mission of operationally responsive recursive orbit by road-based maneuver launch. Considering the requirement of operationally responsive space, the relationship between orbit parameters and launch position is established with the variable of maneuver launch site and the optimization goal of response time. Then the integrated design method of fast access regressive orbit and maneuver launch position in an enclosed area is reached. For a concrete example, the optimized orbit parameters and maneuver launch site corresponding to the shortest orbit response time and task response time are accomplished by the method. STK is successfully used to simulate the planning results with the shortest task response time, demonstrating the feasibility and practicability of the method. The relevant design method can provide theoretical support for the design of operationally responsive orbit and maneuver launch site.

articleTitle: Subaperture Real-time Imaging Algorithm Based on GPU
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Rapid deformation measurement of geological bodies requires radar imaging in real time. The traditional CPU platform is difficult to meet the real-time requirements of high data rate deformation monitoring. In this paper, a GPU-based realtime subaperture imaging method for orbit GB-SAR is proposed. Several methods are used to optimize the key steps of imaging. Generating corresponding parameters and temporarily saving intermediate results on GPU to avoid data transmission during processing. The verification experiment based on the measured data shows that the proposed algorithm has good focusing performance and acceleration performance, and the acceleration ratio can reach 18 to 27, and the relative error of amplitude and phase is close to 0. With the increase of detection distance, the acceleration effect will further improve, and finally the acceleration ratio tends to be saturated at a certain distance.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of High Stability Fiber Bragg Grating Track Axle Counting System
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: At present, track circuit and electromagnetic axle counter are mainly used in track occupancy monitoring technology. However, due to the poor anti-corrosion and anti-electromagnetic interference ability of electrical sensing elements, especially in thunderstorm weather, their working reliability is greatly reduced. Fiber Bragg grating sensing technology uses optical signals to sense and transmit environmental information. In essence, it has strong anti-corrosion and anti-electromagnetic interference ability, so it makes up for the defects of the current electric track axle counting scheme. Therefore, this research uses the advantages of fiber Bragg grating sensing technology, adopts edge filter demodulation method and embedded technology to realize a high stability fiber Bragg grating track axle counting system. This paper mainly studies the temperature characteristics of linear optical filter, simulates and verifies its temperature drift characteristics, and designs a temperature compensation algorithm to control its temperature wavelength drift within 10pm. For the loosening / falling off function of the axle counter and monitoring sensor of the system, the wavelength drift of 10pm will not affect it, so the system has high temperature stability.

articleTitle: Height Measurement Accuracy Improvement Technology Based on Antenna Array Calibration
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The invention relates to a height measurement precision improvement technology based on antenna array calibration, which adopts a theodolite, a static level-meter and a dynamic level-meter; Calibrating the true levelness by the theodolite, correcting the structural error in the data of the static level-meter by using the true levelness calibrated by the theodolite, installing the dynamic level-meter on the array. The theodolite is used to calibrate the system error of the dynamic level. The theodolite of the invention is used for calibrating the true levelness, utilizes the calibration true value of the theodolite to correct the measured values of the static level-meter and the dynamic level-meter, can correct the system errors of the static level-meter and the dynamic level-meter to a very small level. Thereby effectively improving the height measurement accuracy of radar.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Optical Port Isolation Identification Tools for Intelligent Equipments
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: At present, smart substations are popularly used across China, and the case that optical fibers are used as transmission mediums for IEDs in ordinary substations can be seen more and more frequently. In this paper, a new secondary isolation tool is used to solve the problem that the matching of an optical fiber with its slot can only be identified through an identification tag on the optical fiber in the process of optical fiber isolation and restoration, which leads to multiple repeated checks, thereby improving the work efficiency. It is portable and good in practicability. Experiments show that the performing time can be significantly shortened and the performing accuracy can be increased if the new secondary isolation tool is used. Furthermore, it will not affect the quality of optical fiber transmission.

articleTitle: Research on the influencing factors of college students' moral personality and training strategies based on artificial intelligence technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the integration and innovation of artificial intelligence and education has become an important trend of future education reform. The integration of traditional Chinese medicine culture into the cultivation of college students' moral personality has far-reaching significance, which can strengthen college students' feelings of home and country while cultivating college students' complete moral personality. On the basis of existing research, this paper uses the questionnaire survey method to study the influencing factors of college students' moral personality by using the gradual regression analysis statistical method to study the influencing factors of college students' moral personality in a stepwise regression analysis, and further explores the cultivation strategy of college students' moral personality in the artificial intelligence environment. The full and rational use of the rapidly developing artificial intelligence technology and the integration of Chinese medicine culture into the ideological and moral education of college students are of great practical significance for cultivating the sound moral personality of college students.

articleTitle: Design of On-chip FIB for 10G NDN Router Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The Forwarding Information Base (FIB) of the Named Data Network (NDN) is a routing table that forwards according to the name prefix of each Interest packet, which forwards according to the longest name prefix match (LPM) principle. The use of the FPGA on-chip memory can meet the table lookup speed requirement required by the 10 Gigabit transmission rate, but limited by the on-chip storage capacity of the FPGA, there are few FIB entries that can be stored. To this end, a Bit-aparted Trie based on on-chip memory is proposed. This data structure can maintain the query conflict rate at a low level while significantly improving the search speed and reducing storage space requirements. Experiments show that, in Xilinx Zynq 7000 FPGA, Bit-aparted Trie consumes only 9.81Mbit on-chip BRAM, can store 30k routes, and complete all searches in 153.6ns, and the search speed is 2.52 times faster that of the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Image copyright transaction system based on Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of the Internet, the demand for trading the copyright of digital resources is also greater than before. Traditional copyright trading platforms face many problems, such as low efficiency, high single transaction cost, easy privacy leakage, and insufficient data security. This paper proposes an image copyright transaction system based on Hyperledger Fabric, which adds the author's watermark information in the process of data storage, and uses Fabric to store transaction records. IPFS (Interplanetary File System) expands the storage space of the blockchain, and uses the AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) encryption algorithm to encrypt the IPFS hash, which ensures that others cannot steal image resources. Meanwhile, when the customer downloads the image ensures with a watermark, the actual responsible person can be found once the copyright of the image is infringed. The experimental results show that this system can better meet the security requirements of image copyright transaction. In addition, using tape to test the performance of the Fabric network, the throughput of this system can meet the needs of a larger copyright transaction platform.

articleTitle: Multi-target tracking algorithm of vehicle-mounted millimeter-wave radar based on IMM-JPDA-STUKF
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In order to enhance the tracking performance of vehicle-mounted millimeter-wave radar on multi-target vehicles on the road and improve the safety of vehicle driving, this paper proposes a multi-target tracking algorithm of vehicle-mounted millimeter-wave radar based on interactive multi-model joint probabilistic data association strong tracking unscented Kalman filter (IMM-JPDA-STUKF). The scene simulation is carried out according to the change of the common vehicle motion state on the road. The simulation experiment shows that the algorithm can effectively improve the distance and speed tracking accuracy of the vehicle in the multi-target tracking state compared with the IMM-JPDA-UKF algorithm.

articleTitle: An array element mutual coupling error estimation and correction algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The array element mutual coupling error causes the array flow pattern to be biased and perturbed in the estimation of DOA (Direction of Arrival), resulting in estimation performance degradation. To address this problem, a mutual coupling error estimation algorithm based on MUSIC (Multiple Signal Classification) iterative method is proposed. The approach can estimate the array element mutual coupling error and increase Bode direction estimation performance, and simulation results confirm the algorithm's usefulness.

articleTitle: Clustering Algorithm Based on User Power Load
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Cluster analysis is a very important technology and method in data mining, and it is one of the main tasks of data mining. Cluster analysis is to use clustering algorithm to find meaningful classes, mainly based on the similar samples are divided into a class, and the samples with large differences are distinguished, so that the generated cluster is a set of data objects, these objects are similar to the objects in the same cluster, but different from the objects in other clusters. In applications, data objects in a cluster are often treated as a whole. Under the background of China's power grid companies to strengthen the reform of demand side and more effectively carry out economic dispatching of power system osperation, this paper focuses on the study of several classic clustering algorithms at present, analyzes the principle and compares the performance, and expects to choose the most practical method when there is a specific demand.

articleTitle: A Large-scale Distributed Power Access Planning Method Considering Efficiency Benefits
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the intensification of environmental pollution, distributed power generation (DG) has ushered in a golden period of development, and energy storage system (ESS), which can be well matched with distributed power generation to achieve efficient energy utilization, has also gained favor. This paper mainly considers efficiency and benefits and other issues, and conducts research on large-scale distributed power access. This paper establishes an optimization strategy to smooth the load by minimizing the peak-to-valley difference, maximizing the load rate, and minimizing the load variation under a specific energy storage capacity, and analyzes the load curve optimization effects of the three optimization strategies under different energy storage capacities. The experimental results show that although the objective expressions of the three optimization strategies are different, in essence, they can play a certain role in cutting peaks and filling valleys and smoothing the load.

articleTitle: Development of Virtual Simulation Experiment System of HVAC Pipe Network Under VR Technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Based on VR technology, 3D modeling technology and Web3D and other information technologies, with the help of Unity3D, 3ds Max, Solid words and other software tools to complete the design and construction of functional projects, and to complete the construction and release of the HVAC pipe network virtual simulation experiment system under the ASP.NET environment.The system takes network online education as the main form, combined with virtual simulation experiment technology to complete the experimental teaching of HVAC pipe network design.The system will meet the actual needs of students or teachers through simulation experiment, interactive q & A and experimental summary, and help students to improve the design ability and analysis ability of the HVAC cold and hot water system.At the same time, it also provides convenience for teachers' daily teaching, promotes the construction and development of HVAC discipline, and makes a beneficial attempt for the reform of university education informatization.

articleTitle: Implementation Technology of DC Current Step Standard Based on TMR Sensor
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The study of transient step characteristics is very important for the transmission characteristics of DC transformers and the evaluation of the operation state of DC control and protection systems. Aiming at the problems existing in the step response test of the current transient standard in the transient closed-loop test technology, a realization technology of the DC current step standard based on the TMR sensor is proposed. And puts forward an implementation technology of DC current step standard based on TMR sensor. It used a Wheatstone bridge through the TMR sensor and output the voltage signal through the modulation circuit to realize the rapid step and accurate acquisition of current in the process of transient step, corrected the output current amplitude of TMR sensor by the steady-state transmission accuracy of the high precision resistor, then fitted the transient data of TMR sensor with the steady-state data of high precision resistance, which through the data fitting technology of AD conversion, output the complete standard data of the current transient step. Finally, the feasibility of the current step standard technology is verified by its application in the step response test of DC current transformer.

articleTitle: Secrecy Performance for a Hybrid Satellite-FSO Communication System
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the growing demand for transmission range and quality of communication networks, the satellite communication has attracted wide attention. On the other hand, information security plays an important role in communication networks. Therefore, this study investigates the secrecy performance for a dual-hop satellite and free-space optical (FSO) communication system. Specially, a satellite first sends confidential messages via an intermediate terrestrial relay over a radio frequency link, which decodes the received electrical signal and converts it into an optical signal, and then forwards it to a destination under the wiretapping of an eavesdropper. Assuming the satellite and and FSO channels undergo shadowed- Rician fading and Málaga-distributed atmospheric turbulence fading, the analytical expressions for secrecy outage probability and the probability of strictly positive secrecy capacity are presented and validated by Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Quantization Algorithm for Human Foot Detection Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of the artificial intelligence industry, the level of automobile intelligence is getting higher and higher. Among them, the inductive electric tailgate system, as an important configuration for high-end cars to enhance user experience, also uses various sensing technologies. The traditional inductive electric tailgate uses a capacitive electric field sensor to trigger the electric tailgate switch by analyzing the electric field signal changes of two electrodes installed at different positions. The biggest drawback of this method is that it is easy to touch by mistake. Once an object is swept under the tailgate, the electric switch will be triggered to open the trunk. To this end, based on the NanoDet network model, this paper proposes a quantification algorithm for human foot detection based on a convolutional neural network to detect whether the position of the user's foot is within a preset range, to determine the user's intention to open the door. Through the deep learning target detection method, the target position in the natural scene is identified, the model is compressed and quantized, and the floating-point operation is converted into a fixed-point operation, which can not only quickly detect the position of the human foot, but also facilitate the deployment of the model to the edge computing platform. In this paper, we choose the PyTorch deep learning framework and validate the proposed algorithm in Ubuntu 18.04 operating system. The experimental results show that the quantization algorithm compresses the network model from 7.1MB to 1.1MB, the compression ratio reaches 84.5 %, and the accuracy rate only drops by 1.2%. The experimental data illustrate that after quantizing the parameters of the convolutional neural network, the algorithm can effectively compress the model with a small loss of accuracy, which solves the problem that the convolutional neural network is difficult to deploy to the edge computing platform.

articleTitle: Research on Data Ownership Based on High Dimensional and Multisource Characteristics of Energy Data
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This paper studies the transaction and transfer of data ownership and use right when energy data is traded as a commodity, including exchange right, transaction use right, income retention right, disposal right and possession right, which is used to divide the responsibility subjects after the transaction and provide theoretical basis for the operation of energy data trading.

articleTitle: Semi-global Stereo Matching Algorithm Based on Census Transform
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the center point of traditional Census transform window is vulnerable to the noise of outer boundary environment and the area of partial depth discontinuous area has low matching precision in stereo matching, a semi-global stereo matching algorithm based on anti-noise Census transform is proposed. Parallax graphs with a higher degree of match can be output. Firstly, by preprocessing the image, more information of the image can be retained and noise interference can be removed. Meanwhile, the Census algorithm is improved to overcome the dependence on the center pixel of the window and enhance the anti-interference of the initial generation value against noise. Secondly, in the cost aggregation stage, Sobel edge detection is used for cost aggregation. Then, the initial aberration is determined according to the rule that the winner is king. The last is the parallax optimization, through the left-right consistency detection strategy to reduce the false match points, improve the parallax accuracy of occlusion points, and finally get a fine parallax map. Compared with other stereo matching algorithms on Middlebury Vision website, the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is superior to other stereo matching algorithms.

articleTitle: Nano TiO2 Hydrophilic Self-Cleaning Coatings
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Nano TiO2 hydrophilic self-cleaning coatings have been widely researched and developed in recent years, which can significantly degrade various organic and inorganic contaminants adhered to the surface due to the solid photocatalytic property of TiO2. This coating can dramatically reduce the cost of labouring and maintenance and positively impact the environment, which can be widely utilized in various fields like construction, vehicle, and solar energy industries. This paper reviewed the mechanism of the photocatalytic reaction of nano TiO2 hydrophilic self-cleaning coatings that can degrade the dirt on the surface of the substrates and put forward an explanation of the principles of three typical preparation methods in detail, including photosensitive sol-gel, hydrothermal, and atmospheric pressure plasma enhanced CVD (AP-PECVD). In addition, it not only highlighted the applications of these coatings, including photocatalytic TiO2 hydrophilic self-cleaning coatings, antireflective TiO2 super-hydrophilic self-cleaning coatings, and antifogging TiO2 super-hydrophilic self-cleaning coatings with some examples of commercialized products like tiles, construction materials, glass, and solar panels, but also evaluated and discussed some challenges of these nanocoatings like the adhesion problem, TiO2 photocatalytic performance, durability, and some preparation problems with relevant potential solutions.

articleTitle: Application of digital twin technology based on urban brain in logistics management of smart hospita
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: This research will focus on the complex urban epitome scene of hospital logistics intelligence, study how to further integrate the accurate image of digital clues and dynamic evolution information modeling technology on the basis of intelligent IOT, and establish a highly integrated data closed-loop enabling new system to generate a global digital virtual image space, so as to lay a foundation for improving hospital logistics services and realizing a high degree of integration of logistics services.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Leach-x Routing Protocol based on Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: From the perspective of cluster head selection, the LEACH algorithm introduces the concept of rounds and continuously performs cluster reconfiguration cyclically during operation. In each round, during the cluster establishment phase, the node decides whether to become a cluster head node based on the random number generated by itself and the threshold T(n), which can effectively control the energy loss rate of the node and prolong the lifetime of the WSN compared with other algorithms. However, the LEACH algorithm only introduces the concept of rounds, but does not consider the current energy of nodes when selecting cluster heads, which may lead to accelerate the rate of node death and lead to a shorter life span of WSN network structure and a slower transmission speed. To solve this problem, we introduced the current energy factor as a compensation mechanism in the cluster head selection, which reduces the probability of lower energy nodes becoming cluster heads. And according to the simulation experiments, as the number of simulated nodes increases, Leach-x significantly delays the first node death time, and increases the final number of nodes surviving and overall extends the lifetime of WSN than Leach does.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent mobile operation platform in the power marketing business
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Because of the problems of low work efficiency and non-standard operation in the current electricity marketing, In this paper, the overall structure, functional design, and other aspects of the adjustment and optimization, high quality to achieve the mobile network based on the external meter reading and electricity, business expansion report and installation, electrical inspection and other business functions. Our comprehensive application " one data source, one business line, and one operation terminal " technical route takes the lead in establishing the full-service work order pool, and put forward the "mobile & back clip" mobile operating mode of the network, to ensure the full process, full link well versed in safety control and standardized operation. The practice shows that the research and development of marketing mobile job applications from traditional operation to a digital operation upgrade, to avoid the manual intervention, plug up loopholes in management rules, and completely solve the marketing core business online and offline synchronization phenomenon.

articleTitle: Fault classification method of alarm information based on TextCNN
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the continuous development of smart grid informatization, the alarm information data generated by the power grid continues to increase. How to use these text data to ensure the stability of the power grid is the main goal of the current power grid. This paper proposes an alarm information-oriented fault classification method based on TextCNN, which realizes the end-to-end discrimination of power grid fault types and promotes the development of power grid intelligence and stability. Firstly, the text of the alarm information is vectorized through the Word2vec model; then the TextCNN model is built to construct a power grid fault classification model based on TextCNN to judge the type of power grid faulty equipment and whether it has protection and whether it is a complex fault; finally, it is verified through the test set. The method has good expressivity in fault classification.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Distribution Algorithm of Face-Recognition Data Based Tourist Volume at Tourist Attractions
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: It has become a common goal that the tourist volume control at a tourist attraction can promote the healthy development of tourism. The number of on-site visitors is intelligently controlled by the application of the Internet of Things (IoT), cloud computing and big data technologies. There are also many pressing problems that need to be resolved for smart tourism, for example, improving the service quality at a tourist attraction, reducing the occurrence of safety accidents, and improving management efficiency. Based on the face-recognition data based tourist volume control model in [3], this paper brings forward an algorithm to calculate the real-time distribution of tourists at a tourist attraction, which is programmed and implemented in Python language. Taking the data model of the Western Xia King’s Tomb (Xixialing) tourist attraction as an example in [3], experiments are carried out by building an experimental data set and demonstrate that the algorithm is effective. It provides a new approach to build visualized smart tourism system with big data under the face recognition data model.

articleTitle: A Design of flexible ramping product mechanism based on the D-1 electric energy trading
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the gradual realization of China's 14th Five-Year Plan, the proportion of installed renewable energy capacity in all regions has increased significantly. In particular, the high proportion of photovoltaic access has brought a large number of ramping flexibility resources to the power system. In order to solve the problem of insufficient ramping capacity of the power systems, it is urgent to design a reasonable and effective ramping product. The flexible ramping product designed in this article can bring positive effect. On the one hand, it can fully release the adjustment ability of existing ramping resources, and prevent the power system from abandoning solar and wind and cutting load due to insufficient ramping; On the other hand, it ensures the reasonable income of ramping resources, thereby encouraging new ramping resources and ensuring the abundance of long-term flexibility resources. The ramping product based on D-1 electric energy trading designed in this paper can realize the sharing of ramping resources through the electric energy trading in D-1, and effectively solve the ramping problem in the market coverage regions. At last, the article proves the benefits of ramping products through an example.

articleTitle: Analysis Method of Capacity Margin of Distribution Lines Based on Load Data
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In order to solve the problem of reducing the margin of distributed photovoltaic grid-connected lines, a method for analyzing the line capacity margin of distribution network based on load data is proposed. First, this paper describes the connectivity between the nodes of the power distribution system by identifying the line topology. It provides the basis for the judgment of line distribution and transformation. According to the load data and line flow, the difference between the maximum transmission power and the actual transmission power is calculated as the capacity margin of the node. This paper makes full use of the capacity of the original distribution line to avoid capacity redundancy. The test results show that the design method can effectively reduce the power loss, improve the capacity margin, and help to improve the stability of the power grid operation.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification System Based on Image recognition and Sensor Network technology
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the development of computer science and technology, the advent of the internet age has promoted the development of the entire society, but it is accompanied by the serious problem of garbage pollution in people's production and life. However, at this stage, low recycling efficiency and traditional recycling methods limit economic development and environmental protection. This paper designs an intelligent recycling system based on image recognition and multi-sensor coordination, which has the functions of real-time detection of garbage classification, cellphone and voice interaction, the remaining volume of the recycling bin detection. The machine vision is used to obtain the recognition confidence of the object, and the main control unit gets the data of the sensor. Under the comprehensive judgment of the recognition confidence and the detection data, the recycling bin classifies the renewable resources which contain plastic bottles, glass bottles and cans.

articleTitle: A-CS: Adaptive Compressive Data Gathering for Chain-type Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Compressive Sensing has been validated as an efficient way for data gathering in chain-type wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Given the sparsity of the sensor nodes’ raw data, each sensor node just needs to send a constant size of data during the multi-hop data gathering, instead of relaying increasing size of data as in traditional data gathering works. However, we notice that the sparsity of raw data in event-involved local region may not be the same as that in the other usual region, which gives us hint that existing compressive sensing based on uniform sparsity of data actually can be improved. In this paper, we propose an adaptive compressive data gathering method A-CS for chain-type wireless sensor networks. Meanwhile, we design an ultra-lightweight localized sparsity variation detection mechanism for determining the event-involved region. Numerous simulation has been conducted, showing the efficiency of the proposed A-CS method.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent recognition and comparative analysis of the aerodynamics of single or compound nasal consonants in Xiahe dialect
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, a computer modeling method is used to compare the pronunciation of nasal consonants and nasal compound consonants in Tibetan Xiahe dialect. This paper analyzes the pronunciation of the single or compound nasal consonants of Xiahe dialect in Amdo Tibetan, and provides some evidence for the existence of voiced consonants in Xiahe dialect from the perspective of speech aerodynamics. The air flow of compound consonant syllables is greater than that of single consonant syllables.

articleTitle: Research on 5G+ Interactive Teaching Implementation Plan
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Under the background of informatization construction of colleges and universities, the use of 5G networks and technologies to help intelligently restore and realize 5G+ interactive teaching is an important transformation and integration model. At the same time, due to special reasons such as the epidemic, students cannot return to school in time and can receive remote knowledge transfer at home. 5G networks are characterized by high bandwidth, low latency and wide connectivity. Combined with the advantages of network slicing technology and edge computing, clear audio and video transmission and smooth communication can be achieved. Build a cloud network integration infrastructure, build a 5G education private network, and build an intelligent interactive classroom (lab). Realize resource sharing across classrooms and campuses, improve resource utilization efficiency, and promote the implementation of online and offline mixed teaching. The implementation of the 5G+ interactive teaching plan is of great significance for improving educational equity and teaching quality.

articleTitle: An intelligent distributed anti-collision control algorithm for UAV swarm formation
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: To improve the control quality and anti-collision performance of the UAV swarm, this paper proposes a new intelligent anti-collision swarm control algorithm based on the advantages of two algorithms, consistency algorithms and reinforcement learning algorithms. The consistency algorithm performs less well in anti-collision aspect, and the reinforcement learning algorithm is unable to convergence in finite time. For eliminating adverse effects of communication jamming environments, this paper combines the consistency algorithm with Fuzzy Q learning algorithm, presenting a new Multi- Agent Consistency-Fuzzy Q learning algorithm (MACFQL). The validity of the algorithm is demonstrated in the section of calculating samples.

articleTitle: Design of low-weight, small-size and high-efficiency equalization circuits based on switched-capacitors
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: An any cell to any cell equalization circuit, which is based on switched capacitors and energy bus, is proposed in this paper. In this equalization topology, any high voltage cell can directly transfer the power to any low voltage cell through energy bus. With the increasing miniaturisation and integration of circuit boards, the topology proposed in this paper reduces the size of the circuit by varying the capacitance and frequency in order to further reduce the area and weight of the circuit. At the same time compared with the equalization circuit using transformers or inductance devices, this circuit has the characteristics of low cost, low-weight, small-size, easy integration and simple control scheme and it is suitable for applictions such as aerospace and unmanned aerial vehicles. The feasibility of the circuit topology is verified by formula demonstration and simulation results.

articleTitle: DG Capacity Optimization Method for Distribution Network Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: The unreasonable DG access capacity will lead to the increase of line loss in distribution network. In order to reasonably plan the power grid, the DG capacity optimization method of distribution network is designed based on improved particle swarm optimization. DG grid connection may change the power flow size and direction of the distribution system. When the DG access capacity is greater than the load value of the connected node, it will cause the system reverse power flow, the reduced current of the system tends to be saturated, and even increase the current of the system, thereby increasing the network loss. Taking the minimum daily operation cost and power fluctuation as the objective function, and the power balance constraints to improve the matching ability between DG and intermittent load are added. The improved PSO algorithm is used to solve function and output the optimization results of DG capacity. The test results show that this design method can give full play to the advantages of DG, effectively reduce the network loss and improve the economy of the system.

articleTitle: Power Allocation in OFDMA Cellular Network Based on the Optimized Water-Filling Algorithms
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: As wireless communication continues to evolve, spectrum resources are becoming increasingly scarce. Therefore, efficient and fair reuse of the spectrum is essential. In this paper, a planar Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) network model with arbitrary numbers of cells is created for experiments. Five algorithms called integer frequency reuse (IFR), fractional frequency reuse (FFR), simultaneous water-filling (SWF), Transmit Interference Temperature Limit (tx-ITL) and a forward-looking game (FLG) are introduced in this paper. This paper proposes a new allocation method that uses only IFR for the central areas to simplify the system, while combining FFR with SWF, tx-ITL or FLG in the edge to achieve a balance between individual fairness and total network capacity. By performing extensive simulation experiments in the generalized OFDMA network model and comparing the results. The experiments show that FFR+IFR3+FLG is the best algorithmic combination due to its ability to control the interference and maximize both individual and collective interests. But it requires a more complex system due to the greater amount of calculation. The experiments also confirm that FFR+IFR3+tx-ITL can improve individual competitive fairness without affecting network capacity. The conclusions of this paper are useful for both wireless communication algorithm research and realistic communication technology applications.

articleTitle: Comparison of Fractional Frequency Reuse and Soft Frequency Reuse for Interference Management
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Frequency allocation is an important issue in wireless communication systems. And frequency reuse is an effective solution to it. In this paper, 3 typical schemes for frequency reuse are introduced, which are the basic integer frequency reuse (IFR) scheme, strict fractional frequency reuse (FFR) scheme and soft frequency reuse (SFR) scheme. IFR was the most original idea of frequency multiplexing. Then FFR and SFR appeared one after another. And now SFR is still a vital scheme for frequency allocation in LTE systems. To have a more detailed comparison of them, computer simulations are conducted in this paper and their performances are assessed by the signal-to-interference-with-noise ratio (SINR), average sum rate of the network, and the outage probability. From the result, it can be found that the SFR network has a greater average sum rate and smaller outage probability generally, and it has a better distribution of SINR among users compared with those in the IFR network and FFR network, which indicates SFR has a better performance among these 3 schemes. This paper has a basic comparison between these 3 schemes that can provide reference data and make the basis of frequency allocation solid.

articleTitle: A space time adaptive processing method based knowledge aided generalized SPICE
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Space-time adaptive processing (STAP) with finite samples is supposed to be a crucial technique for airborne radar systems. In this letter, a novel STAP method-based knowledge aided (KA) generalized sparse iterative covariance-based estimator (SPICE) is proposed which enhance the clutter suppression performance with finite samples. Firstly, we use the prior knowledge of radar system parameters and surface information to obtain the information of clutter ridge, then we construct the dictionary with the knowledge of the clutter. Secondly, we assign different norm constraints on the clutter and noise parameters in the generalized SPICE instead of identical norm constraints in original SPICE. Numerical experiments prove that the proposed algorithm can achieve great clutter suppression performance with finite samples.

articleTitle: Dynamic Optimization Model of Optimal Carbon-energy Combined Flow of Gas-electric Combined System Based on Consistent Hash Algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of modern energy technology and the advancement of the construction of new energy networks, the energy system is facing brand-new changes. The secondary energy based on the grid also has opportunities for transformation. This paper studies the optimal carbon-energy composite flow dynamic optimization model of the gaselectricity combined system based on the consistent Hash algorithm. Based on the literature data, the optimal carbonenergy composite flow of the gas-electricity combined system and the correlation of the consistent Hash algorithm are studied, then understand the theory, then analyze the application of the Hash algorithm in the system, and then use the relevant intelligent algorithm to optimize the optimal carbon-energy composite flow of the gas-electric combined system, and finally verify the optimized model.

articleTitle: Optimal load distribution of thermal power units based on quantum genetic intelligence algorithm
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Reasonable distribution of unit load is an important way for thermal power plants to maximize benefits. Therefore, optimal distribution of unit load is an important research field for the economic and safe operation of thermal power plants. The purpose of this paper is to study the optimal load distribution of thermal power units based on quantum genetic intelligence algorithm. The mathematical load optimization distribution model adopted in this paper is determined, carbon consumption is determined as the optimization index, and the objective function of the mathematical model and the constraints it contains are determined. The theoretical basis of quantum genetic algorithm is analyzed, the structure of the algorithm, the advantages and disadvantages of the algorithm are proposed, an improved quantum genetic algorithm is proposed, and the performance advantage of the improved quantum genetic algorithm is verified. The design algorithms of coding, constraint detection, iteration and other details are studied. Finally, the optimization efficiency is compared and analyzed through the simulation optimization example. The good optimization results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the improved quantum genetic algorithm in solving the optimal load distribution problem of thermal power units.

articleTitle: Spot Center Detection Algorithm For Continuous Frame Extraction In Natural Scene
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In the process of axis calibration of the photoelectric pod, the spot emitted by the laser emitter needs to be used as the image reference center. Therefore, whether the position of the center of the laser spot illuminated by the laser emitter can be accurately detected is the key to the success of axis calibration. This paper presents a method to extract the spot center from the sampled continuous frames in the natural complex background. In the process of spot image sampling, the image jitter will be encountered. The image registration method is used to register the front and rear images; The method of frame difference is used to extract the background of the image; Using the method of maximum variance between classes to find the threshold of accurately extracting the light spot, and solving the maximum connected region to determine the light spot; Finally, the center of laser spot is determined by solving the gray center of gravity. This method has remarkable effect and strong adaptability. It is suitable for real-time axis calibration of photoelectric pod in natural scenes, and meets the needs of axis calibration.

articleTitle: Cooperative fault handling method of 220kV power system based on relay protection and automation
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: In order to avoid the influence of noise signal on the operation state of the power system, improve the fault recovery rate and improve the anti-interference, a collaborative fault handling method for 220kV power system based on relay protection and automation is proposed. The wavelet packet analysis method is used to de-noise the fault signal. According to the de-noising results, an information fusion strategy based on neural network is proposed to achieve fault diagnosis; the objective function and constraint conditions are established to achieve fault recovery; through multi-level differential protection and centralized fault processing Cooperate to complete the cooperative fault relay protection and automatic processing of 220kV power system. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a high recovery rate of fault handling, and the power system is more stable after being processed by this method.

articleTitle: Research on the compensation method for damping mismatch of HRG
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Hemispherical resonant gyroscope (HRG) is a new type of Coriolis gyroscope with broad prospects for development. Damping mismatch is one of the main error sources of rate-integrating hemispherical resonant gyroscope. Aiming at the angle-dependent bias drift caused by damping mismatch, a pre-compensation method and a post-compensation method are proposed, which can reduce the gyro drift by 90%. In addition, a virtual rotation method is proposed for the gyro lockin effect caused by anisodamping, which effectively overcomes the lock-in problem of HRG.

articleTitle: Study on detection method of diabetes retinopathy based on convolution neural network
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a common eye disease caused by diabetes and the leading cause of blindness in diabetic patients. In order to conveniently judge whether a large number of diabetic patients suffer from DR, a computer-aided method for automatic diagnosis of DR is proposed. Different from the previous use of fundus photography to diagnose, innovatively uses the conjunctival image of the eye as the data source, and uses a new convolutional neural network ConvNeXt to train the data set. The accuracy of binary classification task reached 94.8%. In addition, the sensitivity and specificity were 93.3% and 96.4% respectively. The model can be used for DR screening.

articleTitle: The Genetic Algorithm-based Optimal Solution of Water Balance
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: During the industrial production, it is necessary to calculate the water balance, that is, Sigmainflow = Sigmaoutflow. The paper adopts neural network to train the inflow and outflow of a node and parameters of other production conditions, and then employs genetic algorithm to encode and initialize the inflow of the node and parameters of other production conditions. Afterwards, the present study inputs the initial population into the neural network to run a projection, makes a selection according to the fitness function, and proceeds to a reselection based on the crossover variation of the selected individual, in order to calculate the optimal water balance in this node.

articleTitle: Active Extraction Method for Standardized Features of Energy Big Data Based on Dynamic Weighting
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Energy is an important foundation for the development of human society, and it is also an important source for ensuring the sustained and steady growth of the national economy and sustainable utilization. At the same time, the energy consumed by human beings is also increasing day by day. Nowadays, energy has become the material basis for the survival and development of human society, and has a particularly important strategic position in the national economy. Ensuring energy security and development is of great significance to building a modern socialist country. In order to realize the active extraction of standardized features of energy data, this paper proposes a framework for active extraction of energy big data features based on dynamic weighting. Through dynamic weighting, rich and diverse energy data with representative characteristic indicators can be extracted. This paper mainly uses the data method and experimental method to study the correlation between dynamic weighting and energy data extraction methods. In the test, the accuracy of the dynamic weighting method exceeds 0.5. Experimental results show that the method of actively extracting standardized features of energy big data based on dynamic weighting can save time and effort, and is easy to operate, which further improves the accuracy of the measurement results.

articleTitle: The application of nanotechnology in proton exchange membranes fuel cell (PEMFC)
publicationTitle: EEI 2022; 4th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics
abstract: Proton exchange membranes fuel cells (PEMFC) are clean and efficient. To resolve the problems of high cost and service life, nanotechnology has become one of the main applications of proton exchange membrane fuel cells due to its advantages of lightweight, low cost and durability.
